title: Software Developer – AI & Cloud Technologies
description:
Looking for a workplace for the future? At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the map for how we communicate and live our connected lives in the future.
  
We are now looking for Software Developer – AI & Cloud Technologies to join our Customer Service IT team.
  
How you’ll make a difference with us As a Developer, you’ll help shape the future of customer service at Telenor by building integrations between our customer engagement platforms and AI-powered services. You’ll develop scalable, secure and resilient cloud-native solutions that enable better customer experiences in real time.
  
You’ll be part of Customer Service IT team, where our mission is to enable easy and reliable customer service and sales, making it simple for customers to buy and manage Telenor products and services across channels and stores. By combining modern integration technologies with AI, you’ll help us create smoother and smarter customer journeys.
  
Are you the one we’re looking for? We need someone who’s always on their toes! You have a genuine desire to learn and develop so we can continue to meet our customers’ ever-changing needs – today and tomorrow.
  
You’re an experienced developer who combines technical expertise with curiosity and a strong customer focus. You have a genuine passion for AI and emerging technologies and enjoy exploring how new capabilities can improve customer experience without adding unnecessary complexity.
  
You are a confident communicator who builds trust, collaborates well with others, and isn't afraid to challenge ideas in a constructive way to achieve the best outcome. You think proactively, understand the bigger picture and take ownership of driving sustainable solutions forward. Experience from the telecommunications industry is a strong advantage, helping you understand the challenges and opportunities of a fast-moving, customer-centric business.
  
Must-have
  
  

Relevant academic degree in computer science, engineering or a related field
  
  

Experience developing integrations, APIs or microservices.
  
  

Experience using AI tools and services as part of your everyday software development.
  
  

Experience with Java, Python, Node.js or similar technologies.
  
  

Experience working with Kubernetes and containerized applications.
  
  

Experience with CI/CD and automation.
  
  

Nice to have
  
  

Experience with AWS and cloud-native platforms.
  
  

Knowledge of event-driven architecture and real-time integrations.
  
  

Most importantly, you’re curious, collaborative and excited about using technology to create better experiences for our customers.
  
Our promise to you! We are better together. Here, you’ll be part of a family-like and inclusive culture, built on strong shared values and leadership that empowers you with both trust and confidence. We believe in enabling each other to act and make decisions, while always having each other’s backs through ups and downs.
  
We support relationships and societies. Telenor plays a vital role in the society, giving your work a greater purpose. Every day, we create value for millions of people and maintain a customer-first approach where human relationships are at the heart of everything we do.
  
We make room for life. Work from home up to two days a week, if your role allows it. The rest of the time, we create magic together at the office. You also get two ‘give-me-a-break’ days per year for extra time off, and our flexible working hours help you balance your time. We support you through every stage of life with our benefit package, including collective agreements, occupational pensions, wellness allowances, and customized insurance solutions tailored to your needs.
  
We invite you to a career in motion. Your development is at the center of our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours per year for you to deepen your expertise, explore new areas, and develop in your role. Through Telenor Academy and other learning initiatives, you’ll have the tools and freedom to advance your career. If you want to broaden your horizons, we are present throughout the Nordics.
  
Apply today! Will you take the next step in your career with us? We look forward to your application! We review applicants on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait—reach out today.
  
If you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to contact the hiring manager [Contact Person] at [Contact Details]. Please note that we cannot accept applications via email.
  
Good to know As part of Telenor’s policy, we conduct background checks on final candidates for all recruitments.

title: Senior utvecklare
description:
Vill du inte bara bygga ett datalager? Utan samtidigt vara med och påverka hur framtidens beslut kommer att fattas?
  
De flesta jobbannonser börjar med en kravlista, så vi på We are Pears tänkte göra precis tvärtom.
  
Så om du är den person som alltid ser sambanden bakom datan. Den som stör sig på långsamma SQL-frågor, dåliga datamodeller och lösningar som ingen längre vågar röra. Eller som tycker att BI handlar om affärsvärde – inte bara dashboards.
  
Då tycker vi att du borde läsa vidare.
  
Just nu söker vi en Senior Utvecklare inom Data & Analys till ett långsiktigt uppdrag där du inte bara får vara med och utveckla nästa generations data- och analysplattform hos en av Sveriges mest teknikintensiva verksamheter.
  
För det här är inte ett uppdrag där du kommer in för att "förvalta det som finns".
  
Det handlar istället om att modernisera, förbättra och bygga vidare på en plattform som ska bära verksamhetens beslut under många år framöver.
  
Om uppdraget
  
Du blir en nyckelperson i ett erfaret utvecklingsteam där fokus ligger på data engineering, BI och datalagerutveckling. Där organisationen befinner sig mitt i en moderniseringsresa där nya datakällor, ökade analysbehov och nya teknologier driver utvecklingen mot en mer skalbar och framtidssäker arkitektur.
  
Här får du kombinera operativ utveckling med tekniskt ledarskap och du förväntas inte bara lösa problem utan även att hjälpa teamet att tänka smartare.
  
  

**Det här kommer du faktiskt att göra:**  

* Utveckla och vidareutveckla datalager och BI-lösningar
* Designa och optimera ETL- och ELT-flöden
* Förbättra datamodeller, affärslogik och databaser
* Identifiera flaskhalsar och optimera prestanda
* Arbeta nära verksamheten för att omvandla behov till fungerande analyslösningar
* Bidra till modernisering av dataarkitektur och tekniska vägval
* Coacha och dela kunskap med andra utvecklare
* Skapa lösningar som blir enklare att förvalta över tid


Tekniken du kommer arbeta med
  
Du behöver inte kunna allt, men mycket av detta kommer kännas bekant.
  
Data & BI
  
* Microsoft SQL Server
* T-SQL
* ETL / ELT
* SSIS
* SSAS
* Power BI


Utveckling
  
* Visual Studio
* Azure DevOps
* Agila arbetssätt
* Kanban


Meriterande
  
* Python
* Microsoft Fabric
* Databricks
* Azure Data Factory
* AI & Machine Learning
* Modern Data Engineering
* Data Mesh


Vem tror och hoppas då vi att du är?
  
We are Pears tror faktiskt inte att de bästa utvecklarna definieras av antalet certifieringar, utan kännetecknas av något annat.
  
Du gillar förhoppningsvis därför att lösa problem där svaret inte redan finns och kan ta ett komplext behov, bryta ned det och leverera en lösning som faktiskt används.
  
Du har också arbetat tillräckligt länge för att veta att teknik bara är halva lösningen och att den andra halvan handlar om människor.
  
Du kommunicerar enkelt med både utvecklare och verksamhet och tycker om att hjälpa andra att bli bättre.
  
Varför tror vi då att det här uppdraget sticker ut?
  
För att du inte bara får utveckla kod utan får påverka hur en modern dataorganisation ska se ut de kommande åren.
  
Du blir en del av ett team som värdesätter kvalitet framför genvägar. Så här finns både tekniska utmaningar och möjlighet att sätta ett tydligt avtryck.
  
Ett ord från vår VD Anders Åberg
  
"Vi rekryterar inte bara konsulter, utan bygger team där människor kan utvecklas och skapa verklighet av sina visioner tillsammans. För mig handlar rätt uppdrag om mer än teknik – det handlar om att ge skickliga människor förtroendet att påverka på riktigt."
  
Anders Åberg
  
CEO, We are Pears
  
Därför väljer seniora konsulter Pears
  
Vi tror att riktigt bra människor söker mer än nästa uppdrag. De söker sammanhang, utveckling och frihet.
  
Därtill möjligheten att arbeta med andra som bryr sig lika mycket om kvalitet som de själva gör, så på Pears bygger vi långsiktiga relationer – såväl med våra kunder som våra konsulter.
  
Vi tror på små beslutsvägar, högt förtroende och uppdrag där din kompetens gör verklig skillnad.
  
  

**Pears arbetar inom:**  

AI & Data
  
Enterprise Architecture
  
Systemutveckling
  
Cloud & DevOps
  
Cyber Security
  
Projektledning
  
Digital Transformation
  
  

Praktisk information
  
**Omfattning:** 80–100 %
  
**Start:** Enligt överenskommelse (planerad start i september)
  
**Placering:** På plats hos kund i Västerbotten, med viss möjlighet till distansarbete enligt överenskommelse
  
**Långsiktigt uppdrag:** Initialt till september 2027 med möjlighet till förlängning
  
Nyfiken?
  
https://www.linkedin.com/in/andersaberg/
  
Vi tror inte på krångliga ansökningsprocesser.
  
Skicka ditt CV, din LinkedIn-profil eller bara ett meddelande så tar vi ett första samtal.
  
Det viktigaste är inte att du kan bocka av varje punkt utan att du vill bygga lösningar som faktiskt gör skillnad.
  
Ansök via www.pears.se
  
We are Pears
  
People. Technology. Transformation.

title: Vi söker en erfaren Optimizely-utvecklare!
description:
Vi söker nu erfarna fullstackutvecklare inom Optimizely med minst 7 års erfarenhet som vill ta nästa steg i karriären. Vi har flera spännande uppdrag där du får möjlighet att arbeta med moderna webbplattformar, avancerade integrationer och skalbara lösningar hos våra kunder.
  
Vi söker dig som har bred kompetens inom både backend och frontend och som har erfarenhet av att arbeta med Optimizely CMS/Commerce (tidigare Episerver). Du har god kunskap inom C# och .NET/.NET Core samt erfarenhet av moderna tekniker som Blazor, Razor, React, JavaScript, HTML och CSS. Har du dessutom arbetat med integrationsprojekt ser vi det som mycket meriterande.
  
Vi tror även att du har erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure eller AWS, CI/CD och DevOps-arbetssätt samt databaser såsom SQL Server.
  
Som person tror vi att du är en medel-senior till senior utvecklare som trivs i större team och är van att arbeta agilt enligt Scrum. Du är lösningsorienterad, kommunikativ och gillar att samarbeta nära både kunder och kollegor för att skapa affärsvärde genom teknik.
  
Om oss
  
På Chas kombinerar vi teknik, entreprenörskap och samhällsnytta. Vi erbjuder våra konsulter spännande uppdrag hos marknadsledande företag inom både privat och offentlig sektor, samtidigt som vi satsar stort på kompetensutveckling och gemenskap.
  
Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med moderna tekniker, gå utbildningar via vår egen skola, delta på konferenser och utvecklas tillsammans med engagerade kollegor. Vi tror på att ha kul tillsammans och arrangerar regelbundet events och aktiviteter för hela bolaget.
  
Vi är också stolta över vårt starka CSR-engagemang och vårt fokus på att skapa positiv påverkan – både för våra medarbetare och samhället i stort. Som en del av Chas blir du en del av en kultur där utveckling, delaktighet och innovation står i centrum.

title: Software Developer - Olink NPX
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**

**Job Description**  

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Location/Division Specific Information**
------------------------------------------


We are the Proteomic Sciences division (former Olink Proteomics). Our solutions are transforming the understanding of human diseases through advanced protein biomarker discovery. With our innovative Olink solutions – including highly specific and validated assays that cover more than 5,000 proteins – our colleagues and technology empower scientists in groundbreaking research that will play a pivotal role in the future of personalized medicine.

**Position Description**
------------------------


We are looking for a Software Developer to join our Olink NPX team as part of our Software Development department at our HQ in Uppsala. Our Software Developers work in agile teams and across the stack to build innovative, high-quality applications.


As a Software Developer, you will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of our software solutions. Working closely with fellow developers, data scientists, Product Owners, and other stakeholders, you will help deliver reliable applications that support cutting-edge scientific research. You will take ownership of your work, continuously develop your technical skills, and contribute to the success of the team.


Our NPX software platforms provide data analysis capabilities and processing pipelines supporting our Olink products. They are used by customers worldwide to generate and quality control proteomics data produced in laboratories and are an integral part of groundbreaking medical research.

**Main Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Develop, test, and maintain our NPX software with a strong focus on quality and reliability.
* Collaborate with developers, data scientists, Product Owners, and other stakeholders to deliver customer value.
* Participate in technical discussions and contribute to software design and implementation.
* Translate functional requirements into well-structured, maintainable code.
* Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve software issues.
* Participate in code reviews and continuously improve code quality and development practices.
* Work across the technology stack as needed.
* Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and domain knowledge.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Minimum of 3+ years of professional experience in software development.**
* Experience with C#/.NET and familiarity with a frontend framework (we use Avalonia UI).
* Experience with modern software development practices, including Git, automated testing, and Agile methodologies.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional team.
* Full professional proficiency in English and Swedish is a must.
* Knowledge of biological sciences and bioinformatics is a plus.

  

If you are a curious person who enjoys learning new things and thrives in a collaborative and open environment, this could be the right opportunity for you.

  

You should be based around the Uppsala or Stockholm region and be able to attend our Uppsala HQ on a regular basis. We work three days from the office with the flexibility to work from home two days per week.

 **Apply today!**


If you believe you’re the right fit for this role, we encourage you to submit your resume along with a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.


Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Eat Cook Joy is building the world's largest foundational model trained for food and making it accessible to people through a simple to use copilot interface. We are growing our team in Stockholm, Sweden.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This full-time, on-site Software Engineer role is based in Stockholm, Sweden. A and focuses on building and maintaining the core platform that connects clients with personal chefs. Day-to-day responsibilities include designing, implementing, and testing backend services, APIs, and integrations that support scheduling, payments, and user management. The Software Engineer will collaborate with product and design teams to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable software solutions. The role also involves troubleshooting production issues, improving system performance, participating in code reviews, and contributing to technical documentation and best practices.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Foundational knowledge in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
* Hands-on experience in Software Development and Programming, using modern languages and development tools.
* Strong skills in Back-End Web Development, including building RESTful APIs and working with databases.
* Proficiency in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and applying OOP concepts to design maintainable, modular systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure), version control (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to collaborate in a startup environment, communicate clearly with cross-functional partners, and take ownership of features from concept to deployment.
* Interest in food, hospitality, or marketplace platforms is a plus, along with prior experience at early-stage startups.

title: Founding Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Stackbirds is a lightweight interface that makes it incredibly easy for small businesses / rest of the world not in enterprise with large budgets to adopt AI. Through our interface, businesses can record the things they do and automatically get an agent which repeats those actions on their behalf. We are growing quickly and looking for founding engineer based on Stockholm for our engineering team.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 As a Founding Software Engineer at Stackbirds, you will design, implement, and maintain core back-end services and APIs that power our products. You will work closely with founders and cross-functional partners to define technical requirements, choose frameworks and tooling, and establish engineering best practices. Day-to-day responsibilities include writing production-quality code, performing code reviews, improving system performance and reliability, and contributing to architecture decisions. You will also help build continuous integration and deployment pipelines, monitor systems in production, and troubleshoot issues as they arise. This is a full-time, on-site role based in San Francisco, CA, with significant influence on the company’s technical roadmap and engineering culture.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and systems design.
* Proficiency in Software Development and Programming with modern languages and frameworks.
* Hands-on experience in Back-End Web Development, building and maintaining APIs and services.
* Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and patterns.
* Experience designing scalable architectures, working with databases, and integrating third-party services.
* Comfort with DevOps practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and monitoring.
* Ability to operate in a startup environment: ownership mindset, adaptability, and strong communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Fullstack Developer to Ahlsell
description:
**About The Role**
 Ahlsell is looking for a Fullstack Developer to join our e-commerce team — a key role in the continued modernization of our e-commerce platform. You'll work close to both technology and business in a team that takes shared ownership of the platform powering Ahlsell's websites and mobile applications.
   

  

 In this role, you'll help develop, maintain and evolve full-stack solutions that deliver an excellent experience for customers and internal users. You'll be part of Ahlsell Group's ongoing journey to modernize the tech stack — building cloud-ready, scalable solutions with a strong focus on quality, reliability and performance. We're building this step by step, and you'll help shape how we get there.
   

  

**Where you'll work**
 This is a remote-first role. The team works distributed across Sweden, and you can be based anywhere in the country. If you'd prefer to spend some or all of your time at an office, you're welcome to work from any of Ahlsell's locations across Sweden — whichever suits you best. We collaborate primarily online and meet up in person when it adds value. Team gatherings are usually held at our HQ in Stockholm.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
* Develop and maintain full-stack solutions across React, .NET/C# and databases, contributing to performance and scalability in distributed systems.
* Contribute to architecture and modernization initiatives, including microservices, event-driven patterns, modern integrations and cloud-ready solutions.
* Improve reliability, observability and testability through tools such as Grafana and OpenTelemetry, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
* Collaborate closely with developers, UX, product and business stakeholders to make decisions together.


**What We're Looking For**
 We're looking for a developer who enjoys taking responsibility and contributing to technical decisions in a collaborative environment. You're curious, proactive, and comfortable when not everything is predefined — and you value working things out together with your team. You're interested in the business context, not just the code, and you bring strong communication skills to the table.
   

  

**Required Experience**
* A few years of professional experience in backend development with C# / .NET
* A few years of professional experience in frontend development with React
* Comfortable working in environments where priorities evolve and where the team has real influence over how work gets done
* Background in E-commerce
* Experience with CMS and search solutions (e.g. Optimizely/EPiServer, Voyado Elevate)


**Nice to have (any of these are a plus — you don't need all of them)**
* Interest in architecture and platform-oriented development
* Experience with cloud and infrastructure (Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform)
* Knowledge of CI/CD, monitoring and observability
* Experience using AI tools in development, such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code


**A note on applying**
*We know that no one ticks every box — and research shows that strong candidates often hold back from applying unless they meet every requirement. If you have solid experience in full-stack development and you're excited about the role, we'd love to hear from you.*

title: Software Engineer (AI Training)
description:

 What if the code you write could directly shape how the next generation of AI understands and generates software? We're looking for Software Engineers in Stockholm to build, evaluate, and improve AI-generated code — helping train AI systems to think like real developers.
   

  

 Stockholm is one of Europe's most celebrated technology ecosystems — the city that gave the world Spotify, Klarna, and a generation of world-class engineers. Now you can bring that engineering culture to the frontier of AI development, entirely on your own schedule.
   

  

 You'll write solutions, review AI outputs, and provide the expert-level feedback that makes AI coding assistants smarter, safer, and more reliable. This is hands-on engineering work — not theoretical, not bureaucratic, and not boring.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. If you can write clean code and explain your reasoning, we want to hear from you.

**What You'll Do**

* Background in code review, technical writing, or mentoring junior developers

**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs

title: Software Developer – AI & Cloud Technologies
description:
**Looking for a workplace for the future?**
 At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the map for how we communicate and live our connected lives in the future.
   

  

 We are now looking for Software Developer – AI & Cloud Technologies to join our Customer Service IT team
 **.
   

  

 How you’ll make a difference with us**
 As a Developer, you’ll help shape the future of customer service at Telenor by building integrations between our customer engagement platforms and AI-powered services. You’ll develop scalable, secure and resilient cloud-native solutions that enable better customer experiences in real time.
   

  

 You’ll be part of Customer Service IT team, where our mission is to enable easy and reliable customer service and sales, making it simple for customers to buy and manage Telenor products and services across channels and stores. By combining modern integration technologies with AI, you’ll help us create smoother and smarter customer journeys.
   

  

**Are you the one we’re looking for?**
 We need someone who’s always on their toes! You have a genuine desire to learn and develop so we can continue to meet our customers’ ever-changing needs – today and tomorrow.
   

  

 You’re an experienced developer who combines technical expertise with curiosity and a strong customer focus. You have a genuine passion for AI and emerging technologies and enjoy exploring how new capabilities can improve customer experience without adding unnecessary complexity.
   

  

 You are a confident communicator who builds trust, collaborates well with others, and isn't afraid to challenge ideas in a constructive way to achieve the best outcome. You think proactively, understand the bigger picture and take ownership of driving sustainable solutions forward. Experience from the telecommunications industry is a strong advantage, helping you understand the challenges and opportunities of a fast-moving, customer-centric business.
   

  

**Must-have**
* Relevant academic degree in computer science, engineering or a related field
* Experience developing integrations, APIs or microservices.
* Experience using AI tools and services as part of your everyday software development.
* Experience with Java, Python, Node.js or similar technologies.
* Experience working with Kubernetes and containerized applications.
* Experience with CI/CD and automation.


**Nice to have**
* Experience with AWS and cloud-native platforms.
* Knowledge of event-driven architecture and real-time integrations.


 Most importantly, you’re curious, collaborative and excited about using technology to create better experiences for our customers.
   

  

 Please note that applicants must have the legal right to work in Sweden at the time of application. The position can be based in either Stockholm or Karlskrona. Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available for this role.
   

  

**Our promise to you!**
*We are better together.* 
 Here, you’ll be part of a family-like and inclusive culture, built on strong shared values and leadership that empowers you with both trust and confidence. We believe in enabling each other to act and make decisions, while always having each other’s backs through ups and downs.
   

  

*We support relationships and societies.* 
 Telenor plays a vital role in the society, giving your work a greater purpose. Every day, we create value for millions of people and maintain a customer-first approach where human relationships are at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

*We make room for life.* 
 Work from home up to two days a week, if your role allows it. The rest of the time, we create magic together at the office. You also get two ‘give-me-a-break’ days per year for extra time off, and our flexible working hours help you balance your time. We support you through every stage of life with our benefit package, including collective agreements, occupational pensions, wellness allowances, and customized insurance solutions tailored to your needs.
   

  

*We invite you to a career in motion.* 
 Your development is at the center of our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours per year for you to deepen your expertise, explore new areas, and develop in your role. Through Telenor Academy and other learning initiatives, you’ll have the tools and freedom to advance your career. If you want to broaden your horizons, we are present throughout the Nordics.
   

  

**Apply today!**
 Will you take the next step in your career with us? We look forward to your application! We review applicants on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait—reach out today.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**⚡️ What We Do**
 Flower is Flexible Power. We are a next-gen energy company leveraging AI and machine learning to make renewable energy stable and always available – even when the sun isn’t shining and the wind isn’t blowing.
   

  

 Through smart optimization and trading of energy assets like wind and solar farms, battery systems, and EV chargers, we make renewable energy reliable and predictable, leading the charge towards the energy system of tomorrow.
   

  

**🌟 Who We Are**
 Tech company at heart – purpose in our DNA. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.
   

  

 At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.
   

  

 To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a passionate and skilled Software Engineer to join our Asset Optimisation domain.
   

  

 👩‍💻
 **About The Role**
 Our optimization services decide how Flower's flexibility and renewable portfolios are allocated across energy and balancing markets, from days in advance, continuously updating right up to delivery. Our systems run fully automated and dispatch hundreds of MWs of flexible capacity to where the grid or market needs it most.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer, you will join a quant-heavy team of data scientists, optimization engineers and energy market experts. Your focus is the engineering side of these services: architecture, tooling, reliability, system interfaces, observability. This is a hands-on role - you will write code every day and own the standards and foundation the rest of the team builds on.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the structure and quality of our optimization codebase - architecture, refactoring, testing - and set the engineering bar the team works to
* Ensure the optimization stack holds up as we scale our portfolio to GW-scale and new geographies
* Standardize what is currently bespoke, and decide what has to be rebuilt versus hardened
* Handle reliability and edge cases in the trading path, define graceful failure modes - for example, what should happen when a bid submission fails halfway through?
* Define interfaces towards other teams and take part in those discussions on behalf of the team
* Own our optimization environments, infosec hygiene & testing infra across our services
* Maintain and improve CI, deployments, observability and alerting


**Who You Are**
* ~ 3–7 years of experience building and running software in production
* Fluent in Python and related tooling (uv, prek, ruff, ty, FastAPI, Pydantic, DuckDB)
* Experience managing quantitative models in production (simulation, optimization, heavy batch compute, ML workloads)
* Experience with AWS (Modal is a plus)
* Hands-on across the stack, from architecture down to repo settings, pipelines and environments, and the occasional internal frontend
* Solid instincts for system design and API boundaries, comfortable having these conversations with adjacent teams
* Pragmatic - you can tell a bad idea from a good one on your own, and you know when good enough is good enough
* Motivated to work in energy markets & in a trading environment


**📍 Location**
 Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm, just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.
   

  

**✉️ Apply**
 Our corporate language is English, as we have about 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.
   

  

 Throughout the recruitment process you will meet with the Talent Partner, the Head of Predictions & Asset Optimization, our Product Manager, the Team for a tech assessment and the VP of Engineering.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Software Integration Engineer

 Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

 We are looking for a software integration engineer who can champion the delivery of features in our newest product. This involves working across software and hardware to ensure that the full system is integrated together seamlessly when it needs to be delivered to the customer.

* An understanding of electronic systems and how how to setup and debug them
* Experience with developing or testing software applications
* Software development experience in Python or C/C++
* Familiarity with Linux development and Bash scripting


**Nice To Have**

* Experience interacting with customers to deliver projects that meet their requirements
* Experience developing software for large projects (CI/CD, release process, etc)

title: Senior Software Developer till internationellt SaaS-bolag
description:

 Den här tjänsten är en direktrekrytering vilket innebär att rekryteringsprocessen sker genom Bravura och du anställs direkt hos vår kund.
   

  

**Om företaget**
 Du blir en del av ett internationellt SaaS‑bolag med B2B‑kunder och partners runt om i Europa. Verksamheten utvecklar och förvaltar molnbaserade lösningar som används i affärskritiska flöden hos kunder med höga krav på tillgänglighet, skalbarhet och säkerhet.
   

  

 Som Senior Software Developer ingår du i ett erfaret utvecklingsteam med fokus på applikation och ansvar för vidareutveckling av bolagets skalbara molntjänst. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med systerteam, både i Sverige och internationellt, där teamen äger hela livscykeln från utveckling till drift.
   

  

 Vi kan per idag inte gå ut med företagsnamnet för den här tjänsten. Du kommer självklart få veta vilket företag vi rekryterar till under processens gång, som senast när vi ses på en intervju hos oss.

Teamet har fullt ansvar för hela livscykeln – från design och implementation till drift och förbättringar i produktion.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära andra utvecklare, produkt och systerteam inom företag. Fokus ligger på robusta, skalbara lösningar som klarar höga krav på tillgänglighet, prestanda och korrekthet.
   

  

**I Rollen Ingår Bland Annat Att**
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla backendtjänster i en modern mikrotjänstarkitektur
* Arbeta med funktionell programmering på JVM‑plattformen
* Designa, implementera, testa och produktionsätt robusta tjänster
* Arbeta med Kubernetes, PostgreSQL och REST‑API:er
* Underhålla och vidareutveckla användargränssnitt i React vid behov
* Samarbeta tätt med andra team, både nationellt och internationellt


**Utbildning, erfarenhet och personliga egenskaper**
* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, datavetenskap eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av backendutveckling i Java
* Erfarenhet av Kubernetes, PostgreSQL och REST‑API:er
* Goda kunskaper i engelska, i tal och skrift


 Det är meriterande om du också har erfarenhet av
   

  

* Erfarenhet av JVM‑plattformen och Scala
* Frontendutveckling i React
* Transportlogistik och relaterade informationsflöden
* Att bygga AI‑baserade produkter


 Vi tror att rollen passar dig som drivs av att lösa komplexa problem tillsammans med andra och tar ansvar för både kod och helhet. Du är van vid att arbeta i miljöer där tekniska beslut diskuteras öppet, där kod granskas och där kvalitet prioriteras över genvägar. Samtidigt är du nyfiken, lärande och trygg i att röra dig mellan olika tekniska ekosystem när det behövs.

title: King’s C++ Developer Talent Pool
description:
**Craft:**
 Technology & Development
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Join King’s C++ Developer Talent Pool!**
 At King, we're always looking to connect with exceptional C++ engineers who want to build technology at global scale.
   

  

 By joining our
 **Talent Pool** 
 , you'll be considered for
 **current and future opportunities** 
 across our engineering teams. If your background aligns with a role, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will get in touch to discuss it with you.
   

  

**What We Typically Look For**
* Strong professional experience developing software in modern C++
* Excellent understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures and object-oriented design
* Experience building performant, scalable and maintainable systems, with strong debugging and optimisation skills
* Experience in one or more areas such as gameplay systems, game engines, graphics, developer tooling, platform or backend engineering
* Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD, version control and modern development practices
* A collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills and a passion for solving complex technical problems


 While many of our engineers have a background in games, we also hire talented C++ developers from industries such as technology, finance, automotive, telecommunications and other high-performance software environments.
   

  

 For engineers looking to break into the games industry, our Core Tech teams can provide a natural pathway. These teams build the platforms, tools, runtime systems, SDKs and shared technologies that underpin our games, allowing experienced C++ engineers to apply their expertise while gaining exposure to game development at one of the world's leading mobile gaming companies.
   

  

**Why King?**
 At King, you'll have the opportunity to work on technology that reaches hundreds of millions of players worldwide. Our engineers solve challenging technical problems, collaborate with experienced teams, and build platforms and services that operate at massive scale.
   

  

 Whether you're passionate about performance, distributed systems, backend architecture, developer tooling, or cloud technologies, King offers the opportunity to make a real impact.
   

  

***Interested?***
 Submit your profile to our Talent Pool!
   

  

 Every profile submitted is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. If your skills and experience align with the types of C++ opportunities we hire for, we'll add your profile to our Talent Pool and may reach out if a suitable opportunity becomes available.
   

  

 If, after reviewing your application, we don't believe your background aligns with the types of C++ opportunities we typically hire for, we'll let you know and won't be progressing your profile into our Talent Pool at this time. Of course, you're always welcome to apply for any other opportunities at King that match your skills and experience.
   

  

 We appreciate your interest in King and look forward to connecting with you if the right opportunity arises.
   

  

**About King**
 With a mission of
 *Making the World Playful* 
 , King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as
 *Farm Heroes Saga* 
 . King games are played by more than 200 million monthly active users. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Tech Lead inom mobila lösningar
description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten
   

  

 Vill du vara med och utveckla nästa generations mobilapplikationer – och samtidigt skapa verklig nytta för några av Sveriges mest spännande företag inom industri, transport och bygg? Då är CGI rätt arbetsplats för dig! Hos oss på CGI får du arbeta i teknikens framkant när det gäller kompetensutveckling och ny teknik, för att kunna stötta våra kunder i den digitala transformationens snabba förändringstakt.
   

  

 Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Som Tech Lead inom mobila lösningar har du ett övergripande tekniskt ansvar för design, utveckling och förvaltning av mobilapplikationer för iOS och Android. Du leder det tekniska arbetet i teamet och säkerställer att arkitektur, kodkvalitet och leverans håller högsta nivå.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära UX/UI-designers, backend-utvecklare, arkitekter och produktägare och är en nyckelperson i att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till hållbara, skalbara och säkra mobila lösningar, ofta i projekt som påverkar stora delar av våra kunders verksamheter.
   

  

 Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll
   

  

 Vi tror att du har minst 6–8 års erfarenhet av mobilutveckling och flera års erfarenhet av tekniskt ledarskap eller en ledande utvecklarroll. Du är van att ta helhetsansvar och trivs i en roll där du kombinerar teknik, ledarskap och affärsförståelse.
   

  

 Du har även:
   

  

* Djup erfarenhet av minst en mobilplattform (iOS, Android eller cross-plattform).
* Stark kompetens inom mobil arkitektur (MVVM, Clean Architecture, modulär arkitektur).
* Erfarenhet av RESTful API:er, databaser (SQL, NoSQL) och molnplattformar såsom Azure.
* God förståelse för säkerhet i mobilappar (OAuth, JWT, hantering av användardata).
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD, automatiserad testning och DevOps-principer.
* Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt (Scrum, SAFe eller liknande).


 Meriterande är erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Lösningsarkitektur och teknisk roadmap-planering.
* Prestandaoptimering och tillgänglighetsanpassning av mobilappar.
* Arbete i komplexa enterprise-miljöer.


 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du en trygg teknisk ledare som inspirerar andra och skapar struktur i komplexa sammanhang. Du har förmågan att fatta välgrundade tekniska beslut och kommunicera dem på ett tydligt sätt, både till utvecklare och till icke-tekniska intressenter.
   

  

 Du drivs av att bygga hållbara lösningar med hög kvalitet och stark användarupplevelse. Samtidigt motiveras du av att utveckla människor, stärka teamets kompetens och bidra till en kultur där kunskapsdelning och gemensamt ansvar är självklart.
   

  

 I rollen har du möjlighet att arbeta både in-house och hos kund, beroende på projekt.
   

  

 Vill du ta en ledande roll i att forma framtidens mobila lösningar – i en miljö där du får påverka, utveckla och göra verklig skillnad? Välkommen till CGI!
   

  

 Hos oss får du:
   

  

* Leda och coacha utvecklingsteam inom mobilutveckling.
* Sätta teknisk riktning och ansvara för arkitektur och tekniska vägval.
* Arbeta med både native (Swift, SwiftUI, Kotlin/Java) och cross-plattform-lösningar (.NET MAUI, hybridappar).
* Säkerställa best practices inom kodkvalitet, testning och säkerhet.
* Driva DevOps-arbete och vidareutveckla CI/CD-pipelines för mobila applikationer.
* Ansvara för publiceringsprocesser till App Store och Google Play.
* Vara teknisk rådgivare i dialog med kund och bidra i presale och lösningsdesign.


 Vi är en del av CGI:s Developer Center of Excellence (CoE), vilket innebär:
   

  

* Tillgång till ett starkt tekniskt nätverk med några av CGI:s främsta utvecklare
* Kunskapsutbyte, best practices och gemensam teknisk utveckling
* Små team med stort inflytande i det dagliga arbetet
* Styrkan, stabiliteten och möjligheterna i ett globalt bolag
* Tekniskt avancerade projekt med fokus på Microsoft och Azure
* Hög kvalitet i allt vi gör


 Vi kombinerar teknisk spets med en social och inkluderande kultur där vi gör mycket tillsammans:
   

  

* Teamaktiviteter
* After works
* Gemensam fika
* Tekniska workshops etc


 Här är det högt i tak, nära till skratt och stort tekniskt engagemang.
   

  

**Vill du veta mer?**
 Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande så skicka in din ansökan redan i dag! Om du har frågor om rollen, hör gärna av dig till rekryterande ledare Annika Widell, Director Consulting Services/ Konsultchef, på annika.widell@cgi.com
   

  

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**
 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.
   

  

 Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.
   

  

 Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.
   

  

 Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
   

  

 Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
**Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking, from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We’re an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Creating and collaborating to transform the sound of streaming, content, and culture. Come join us, and let the world** 
***feel***
**your work.**
 As a Security Engineer at Epidemic Sound, you will help keep the company safe across three connected surfaces: the products our customers use, the platform our engineers build on, and the systems our employees rely on every day. This is a broad, generalist role where your work directly shapes how an industry-leading company with a startup mentality manages risk and builds securely at scale.
   

  

 Building security automations and custom AI agents is a normal part of how the team operates, and you will be expected to do the same. You will sit within the Business Tech Division and report to the Head of Security, working closely with engineers, SRE, IT, Legal, and People teams across the organisation.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities Include**
* Own the vulnerability management programme across our products, cloud, and corporate estate: discovery, prioritisation, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Consolidate findings across our detection stack into a single risk picture.
* Partner with software engineers to grow the Secure Software Development Lifecycle, including code reviews, threat models, and pre-ship security input.
* Harden the GCP estate, Kubernetes platform, and CI/CD systems our engineers depend on.
* Run vendor security reviews and respond to enterprise customer security questionnaires.
* Operate and tune the Elastic SIEM and broader detection stack, building new detections as the threat picture evolves.
* Respond to security incidents including on-call, and run training exercises to keep the team ready.
* Build and run security agents and automations that other engineers and the wider business rely on, treating them as production-grade software.
* Evaluate AI models and frameworks against security standards.


**Requirements**
* Around five years in security engineering, with depth in at least one of application security, infrastructure security, enterprise security, or vulnerability management, and solid breadth across the others.
* Hands-on experience running or contributing to a vulnerability management programme, including prioritisation, SLA setting, remediation tracking, and reporting.
* Working knowledge of SCA/SAST tooling, Internal Developer Portals, and SIEM; we use Snyk, Port, and Elastic.
* Working knowledge of the security features of the major public cloud providers, with GCP preferred.
* Comfort with Kubernetes, Docker, or other container architectures.
* Confident with at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Go, or Bash.
* Solid experience with Git, GitHub Actions, and Terraform.
* Active, daily use of AI and agentic tools, with concrete examples of agents you have built and outputs you have shipped.
* Experience with vendor security questionnaires.
* Familiarity with common security frameworks such as PCI DSS and NIST.


**It would also be music to our ears if you have**
* Penetration testing background or OWASP Top 10 fluency.
* Experience with CI/CD security hardening at scale.
* A track record of building security tools other engineers want to use.
* Experience reporting vulnerability management and security posture metrics to leadership.
* Familiarity with social engineering attacks, especially phishing, and the controls that reduce them.


**Equal opportunity employer**
 We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.
   

  

**Application**
 Ready to make the world
 *feel* 
 your work? Please apply, in English.

title: Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**CSQ427R155**
 As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data.
   

  

 This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Have**
* Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
* Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
* Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
* Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
* Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
* Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
* Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
* Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.


**What We Look For**
* 6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
* Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
* Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
* Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
* Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
* Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
* Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
* Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
* Documentation and white-boarding skills.
* Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
* Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
* Travel to customers 20% of the time
* Databricks Certification


**About Databricks**
 Databricks is the data and AI company. More than 10,000 organizations worldwide — including Comcast, Condé Nast, Grammarly, and over 50% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI. Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe and was founded by the original creators of Lakehouse, Apache Spark™, Delta Lake and MLflow. To learn more, follow Databricks on Twitter, LinkedIn and Facebook.

 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. title: Senior Fullstack & Mobile Developer
description:

 Plattformen är färdigutvecklad, kommersiellt lanserad och har betalande kunder samt pågående digitala marknadsföringskampanjer.
 



  





 Nu söker vi en senior, hands-on utvecklare som kan ta ett brett tekniskt helhetsansvar för vår etablerade plattform. Rollen omfattar hela produkten – native-appar för iOS och Android, backendtjänster och databaser, webb- och administrationsgränssnittet SoSafe Eye samt molninfrastruktur.
 



 Till en början blir du SoSafes enda interna utvecklare. Det ger dig stort inflytande över både produkten och den tekniska inriktningen. Planen är att bygga ut utvecklingsteamet framöver, vilket ger dig en tydlig möjlighet att växa in i en ledande roll och vara med och forma teamets arbetssätt.
 



  





**Det här kommer du att göra** 



* Utveckla, förvalta, testa, publicera och ge support för iOS- och Android-apparna.
* Förvalta backendtjänster, API, databaser, bakgrundsjobb och realtidskommunikation.
* Förvalta och vidareutveckla SoSafe Eye.
* Ansvara för AWS-infrastruktur, driftsättningar, containrar, CI/CD, DNS, övervakning, säkerhetskopiering och felsökning i produktionsmiljö.
* Ansvara för publiceringar i App Store och Google Play, inklusive signering, granskningsprocesser, utrullning och versionshantering.
* Arbeta nära grundarna och teamet för digital marknadsföring för att omsätta affärs- och produktbehov i väl genomförda leveranser.
* Säkerställa att den tekniska dokumentationen för plattformen och driften är tydlig och uppdaterad.



  





**Tech Stack** 




  





**iOS:** 



* Swift
* UIKit
* Core Data
* WidgetKit
* App Intents
* Core Location
* StoreKit 2
* Swift Package Manager
* CocoaPods



  





**Android:** 



* Kotlin
* Java
* Android SDK
* Activities
* Fragments
* Jetpack Compose
* Room
* Coroutines / Flow
* Retrofit / OkHttp
* Gradle
* Google Play Billing



  





**Backend:** 



* Node.js
* TypeScript
* NestJS
* REST API
* GraphQL
* Socket.IO



  





**Webb & Admin:** 



* React
* TypeScript
* Vite
* Next.js
* Apollo



  





**Databaser & Meddelandehantering:** 



* MongoDB
* PostgreSQL
* Redis
* SQS
* Lambda
* Objektlagring



  





**Moln, Drift & Leverans:** 



* AWS
* Docker
* CI/CD
* Terraform
* Helm
* CloudWatch
* App Store Connect
* Google Play Console



  





**AI-driven utveckling** 




  





 AI-driven utveckling är en central del av rollen.
 



 Du behöver ha god erfarenhet av AI-agenter för kodning, som Claude Code, Codex eller motsvarande, och kunna använda dem effektivt i hela SoSafe-plattformen.
 



  





**Du behöver kunna:** 




  




* Arbeta spec-driven innan kodningen börjar genom att definiera omfattning, berörda system, acceptanskriterier, tester och en tydlig Definition of Done.
* Ge AI-agenter rätt kontext från kodbasen och dela upp plattformsövergripande arbete i små uppgifter som är enkla att granska, med parallella agenter eller isolerade worktrees när det är lämpligt.
* Använda AI för att skapa och köra tester, builds, linters och typkontroller samt verifiera resultaten mot tydliga success criteria istället för att okritiskt acceptera genererad kod.
* Granska varje genererad ändring kritiskt och skydda källkod, åtkomstuppgifter, kundinformation och produktionssystem.
* Säkerställa att arbetssättet går att upprepa och följa i efterhand genom uppdaterade instruktioner i repot, tydliga commits, dokumenterade testresultat och aktuell dokumentation.



  





**Vi söker dig som har** 




  




* Gedigen, praktisk erfarenhet av att utveckla och publicera native-appar för både iOS och Android.
* Fullstackerfarenhet inom backendtjänster, API, databaser och moderna webbapplikationer.
* Erfarenhet av att utveckla applikationer i React och TypeScript.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av att hantera AWS-miljöer, driftsättningar, CI/CD och applikationsövervakning.
* Erfarenhet av att publicera och förvalta appar via App Store Connect och Google Play Console.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att använda AI-agenter för kodning, exempelvis Codex, Claude Code eller motsvarande, för att leverera testade och granskningsbara kodändringar.
* Förmåga att arbeta självständigt, röra dig obehindrat mellan olika delar av produkten och fatta pragmatiska tekniska beslut.
* God kommunikationsförmåga och lätt för att samarbeta nära grundare, marknadsteam och andra kollegor utan teknisk bakgrund.
* Intresse för att växa in i en teknisk ledarroll och bidra till att rekrytera, introducera och stötta framtida utvecklare.
* Erfarenhet från startup, scaleup eller ett mindre produktteam är meriterande.
* Möjlighet att arbete från vårt kontor i Stockholm. Detta är en roll där regelbunden närvaro på kontoret är ett krav.



  





**Det här erbjuder SoSafe** 




  




* En central teknisk roll med stort ansvar och reellt inflytande över produktens framtid.
* En tydlig möjlighet att bli Lead Developer i takt med att utvecklingsteamet växer.
* En etablerad produkt som omfattar mobilappar, webbgränssnitt, backendtjänster, molninfrastruktur och externa integrationer.
* Nära samarbete med grundarna och teamet för digital marknadsföring.
* De verktyg, den utrustning, de behörigheter och de testenheter du behöver för att arbeta med hela plattformen.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Are you passionate about making a sustainable impact in the world of electric transport? Do you thrive in an innovative and entrepreneurial environment? Then you might be the new regional assistant to Erinion!
   

  

 At Erinion, part of the Scania Group, we are leading the global shift towards a more sustainable transport system by shaping the future within charging and e-mobility.
   

  

 Our business
   

  

 We offer private and semi-public charging solutions to build, own and operate infrastructure at customer sites to enhance their operational efficiency, minimize cost and increase flexibility. Erinion is on a fast-paced growth trajectory, if you thrive in dynamic environments fuelled by innovation and collaboration, then Erinion is the place for you!
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 As a Senior Backend Developer, you will play a key role in building and evolving Erinion Connect, our cloud-native Charging Management System (CMS) for smart charging and energy management in commercial transport.
   

  

 Working closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and Applied AI teams, as well as a strategic technology partner, you will design and deliver scalable backend services, integrations and cloud-native solutions that support Erinion's growth.
   

  

 We're looking for an experienced engineer who combines strong backend expertise with architectural thinking. AI-assisted development tools are part of our daily workflow, but we value engineers who can independently drive technical decisions and build robust, scalable systems.
   

  

 This is a backend-first role, with approximately
 **70% of the work focused on platform and integration engineering** 
 and the flexibility to contribute across the stack when needed.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

  

* Build and enhance backend services using Python and Node.js/TypeScript.
* Design scalable APIs, integrations, and event-driven architectures.
* Develop solutions for smart charging, energy management, and fleet platforms.
* Integrate Erinion Connect with TMS, FMS, ERP, and telematics systems.
* Contribute to platform architecture and long-term product evolution.
* Support React-based frontend development when needed.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery.


 Who You Are
   

  

  

* 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering.
* Strong experience with Python and/or Node.js (TypeScript).
* Experience designing and building cloud-native applications on AWS.
* Solid understanding of software architecture, distributed systems and integration patterns.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and cloud storage solutions.
* Experience building REST APIs, microservices and event-driven systems.
* Ability to make sound technical and architectural decisions independently.
* Experience using AI-assisted coding tools in day-to-day development.
* Fluent English.


 Nice to have
   

  

  

* React experience.
* Java experience.
* Experience with TMS, FMS, ERP or telematics integrations.
* Knowledge of OCPP, OCPI or EV charging technologies.
* Experience with TimescaleDB.
* Startup or scale-up experience.


 We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.
   

  

 Core Technology Stack
   

  

**Languages** 
 : Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Java,
 **Frontend** 
 : React
   

  

**Cloud & Infrastructure:** 
 AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, Step Functions, EventBridge, Cognito, S3), CloudFormation, Docker, GitLab CI
   

  

**Databases:** 
 PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, S3, TimescaleDB (nice to have)
   

  

**Architecture & Integration:** 
 REST APIs, Microservices, Event-driven Architecture, WebSockets
   

  

**AI Tooling:** 
 Claude Code, Codex, AI-assisted Development
   

  

 Our offer
   

  

 Join our passionate team in Stockholm city, at Drottninggatan 29, and be a driving force in the future of sustainable transportation. At Erinion, you won't just be a part of the change, you'll be pioneering it. We offer a competitive compensation package, alongside unparalleled professional growth opportunities. This is an early-stage company where your ideas are valued, your contributions have a significant impact, and you have the chance to develop and grow alongside Erinion.
   

  

 Application
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV in English and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-11. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
   

  

 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Karolina Skibińska, Talent Acquisition Spcialist, karolina.skibinska@scania.com or Henrik Karlsson, Head of Technology, henrik.xy.karlsson@scania.com
   

  

 We look forward to your application!

title: Lead Solution Architect
description:
Lead Solution Architect – TimeflowSystem (SaaS, AWS & AI)
 
**Vill du vara med och bygga nästa generations SaaS-plattform för hantverksbranschen?** 




 TimeflowSystem utvecklar en modern molnbaserad affärsplattform som digitaliserar hela arbetsflödet för bygg-, el-, VVS-, måleri-, städ- och serviceföretag. Plattformen omfattar bland annat projektledning, kalkyl, offerter, ekonomi, personal, AI-funktioner och mobilappar.
 



 Vi söker nu en
 **Lead Solution Architect** 
 som vill ta det tekniska helhetsansvaret för vår plattform och vara med på en spännande internationell tillväxtresa.
 


 Om rollen
 
 Som Lead Solution Architect blir du den tekniska ledaren bakom TimeflowSystems arkitektur. Du ansvarar för att säkerställa att plattformen är skalbar, säker och byggd för framtiden.
 



 Du arbetar nära företagets CEO, Product Owner och utvecklingsteam för att fatta tekniska beslut, definiera arkitektur och säkerställa hög kodkvalitet genom hela utvecklingsprocessen.
 


 Arbetsuppgifter
 * Ansvara för den övergripande systemarkitekturen.
* Designa en skalbar och säker SaaS-plattform.
* Definiera arkitektur för backend, frontend och mobilappar.
* Säkerställa hög prestanda, säkerhet och tillgänglighet.
* Ta fram tekniska riktlinjer och best practices.
* Granska kod och stödja utvecklingsteamet i tekniska frågor.
* Planera integrationer mot externa system och API:er.
* Delta i tekniska vägval kring AI, automation och framtida funktioner.
* Arbeta tillsammans med DevOps kring CI/CD, deployment och molninfrastruktur.
* Bidra till långsiktig produktutveckling och teknisk strategi.


 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av
 * Minst 5–10 års erfarenhet som systemarkitekt eller senior utvecklare.
* Design av större SaaS-plattformar.
* AWS eller annan modern molninfrastruktur.
* Python och Django.
* React och moderna JavaScript-ramverk.
* REST API:er och integrationsarkitektur.
* Databasdesign (PostgreSQL eller motsvarande).
* Git, CI/CD och moderna utvecklingsprocesser.
* Säkerhetsarkitektur och autentisering.
* Skalbara distribuerade system.



 Meriterande erfarenheter:
 


* React Native.
* Docker och Kubernetes.
* AI- och LLM-integrationer.
* Microservices.
* DevOps.
* Infrastruktur som kod (Infrastructure as Code).


 Personliga egenskaper
 
 Vi söker en person som:
 


* Är analytisk och lösningsorienterad.
* Trivs med stort tekniskt ansvar.
* Kan fatta välgrundade tekniska beslut.
* Har god samarbetsförmåga.
* Kommunicerar tydligt med både utvecklare och verksamhet.
* Tycker om att bygga produkter med höga kvalitetskrav.


 Vi erbjuder
 * En nyckelroll i ett innovativt teknikbolag.
* Möjlighet att påverka arkitekturen från grunden.
* Arbete med modern teknik och AI-lösningar.
* Internationell expansionsresa.
* Flexibla arbetsformer.
* Konkurrenskraftig lön efter erfarenhet.
* Möjlighet till långsiktig utveckling och framtida ledande tekniskt ansvar.


 Placering
 
 Stockholm eller hybrid. Distansarbete kan diskuteras för rätt kandidat.
 


 Ansökan
 
 Skicka ditt CV tillsammans med en kort presentation där du beskriver tidigare erfarenhet av att designa skalbara system och molnbaserade SaaS-lösningar.
 



 Vi intervjuar kandidater löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.
 



 Ansökan skickas till robert@timeflowsystem.se

title: Backendutvecklare
description:
Sök jobbet
   

  

 Är du en person som vill koda för något större än bara nästa feature? Vill du nörda ner dig i teknik samtidigt som du förbättrar hela Sveriges hälsa? Då kan det här vara en roll för dig.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Som backendutvecklare hos oss jobbar du i ett agilt team där ni tillsammans levererar värde. Hela teamet fokuserar på backend och målet är att skapa robusta digitala tjänster för övriga myndigheten. Vi arbetar kvalitativt i alla led genom både utveckling och testautomatisering. Teamet ansvarar gemensamt för kvaliteten, hjälper varandra där det behövs och driver utvecklingen av våra plattformslösningar. Vi strävar efter att vara i teknisk framkant och du får både eget ansvar och en tydlig roll i helheten.
   

  

 Du får vara med och bygga komponenter som skapar förutsättningar för nationell digital infrastruktur inom hälsa, vård och omsorg. Vi är på en resa där teknik, data och samhällsnytta möts. För att Sverige ska få en mer sammanhållen och tillgänglig digital vård söker vi utvecklare som vill skapa smarta lösningar med verklig påverkan, från första dagen.
   

  

**Om dig**
 I din roll som utvecklare rör du dig obehindrat mellan olika verktyg och miljöer samtidigt som du i grunden är vass på att lösa komplicerade problem. Du är samarbetsinriktad och trivs på jobbet när du får jobba mot gemensamma mål. Det är en självklarhet för dig att driva på ditt eget arbete samtidigt som du också är delaktig i implementeringen av förändringar i teamet.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har:**
* akademisk utbildning om minst 180 hp (120 gamla poäng) inom data/it alternativt likvärdig arbetslivserfarenhet
* flera års erfarenhet av arbete som systemutvecklare där du har använt dig av Java och JPA/Hibernate
* några års erfarenhet av containertekniker som Docker, Kubernetes och OpenShift.


**Det är meriterande för tjänsten om du har:**
* erfarenhet av arbete med skalbara REST‑API:er
* erfarenhet av arbete med Quarkus, Spring Boot eller annat motsvarande modernt Java-ramverk för mikrotjänster
* erfarenhet av säkerhetsutveckling med hjälp av exempelvis Oauth2 och SAML
* erfarenhet av loggstandardisering som JSON‑loggar och korrelations‑ID
* erfarenhet av prestanda- och svarstidstester samt plattformsarbete.


**Vad erbjuder vi?**
 E-hälsomyndigheten är en myndighet i tillväxt och vi driver utvecklingen av nationell digital infrastruktur inom hälsa, vård och omsorg. Vi skapar förutsättningar för digitala tjänster och lösningar för både privatpersoner och professioner inom hälso- och sjukvård, apotek och socialtjänst. Vi arbetar för att hälsodata ska bli tillgängliga i hela vårdkedjan.
   

  

 Vi är cirka 600 medarbetare i Kalmar och Stockholm. Hos oss finns möjlighet att göra skillnad i en innovativ miljö med trevliga och kompetenta arbetskamrater. Alla medarbetare har förtroendearbetstid och kan arbeta delvis på distans. Läs mer om E-hälsomyndigheten som arbetsplats: Jobba hos oss
   

  

**Är du intresserad?**
 Frågor angående tjänsten besvaras av rekryterande chef Per Sjögren, 010-458 6276.
   

  

 Frågor angående rekryteringsprocessen besvaras av HR-specialist Dorothea Lockman-Lundgren, dorothea.lockman-lundgren@ehalsomyndigheten.se

title: Senior Backend Developer – Streaming & CDN
description:
We are currently looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join a CDN & Origin Services team based in Stockholm. In this role, you will be part of a dedicated team delivering streaming media services to millions of users across the Nordic region.
   

  

 You will play a key role in developing and maintaining backend systems that support video and radio encoding, packaging, and distribution. The assignment also includes contributing to the design and scaling of CDN and origin infrastructure, ensuring high performance and reliability.
   

  

 The role involves close collaboration with other development teams, as well as network, datacenter, and support functions. You will also be responsible for troubleshooting, optimizing, and maintaining services in production. The team operates in an agile environment with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain backend systems for media streaming services
* Contribute to the design and scalability of CDN and origin platforms
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams across development, network, and operations
* Troubleshoot and optimize production systems
* Work in an agile setup with a strong sense of ownership


**Required Skills & Experience**
* Minimum 3 years of professional experience with Java SE
* Experience working with distributed systems
* Knowledge of OTT streaming protocols such as HLS, DASH, SRT/MPEG-TS, and RTMP
* Familiarity with video/audio codecs and container formats
* Experience with C or C++
* Experience with scripting languages such as Python or shell
* Strong knowledge of GNU/Linux environments
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP and application protocols, particularly HTTP
* Good understanding of modern software design principles
* Strong communication skills in English (Swedish is a plus but not required)


**Additional Information**
* Location: Stockholm
* Workload: Full-time
* Start: September 1, 2026
* End: June 30, 2027

title: Function Owner (Developer)
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.
   

  

 Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 As a Function Owner, you will be responsible for defining, developing, and maintaining key functions within our software and hardware systems supporting sustainable people's transport solutions. You will work in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where drivability, safety, and innovation are at the core. Your role will be crucial in ensuring premium quality and continuous improvement of our products and digital services.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Function Ownership: Act as the main expert for selected system functions, ensuring their definition, development, and lifecycle management.
* Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams including software engineers, designers, and product managers to align technical and business goals.
* Requirements Gathering: Translate user and stakeholder needs into clear functional requirements aligned with product strategy.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure high standards of reliability, performance, and security through testing, validation, and continuous monitoring.
* Innovation: Stay up to date with industry trends and technologies, proposing improvements and new ideas to enhance existing functions.
* Initiatives & Investigations: Drive improvement initiatives and support technical investigations that push the team forward.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s or master's degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* 7–12 years of experience in software development.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as C++, Python, Java, MATLAB, or Simulink.

* A problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail.

**This Is Us**

 You will join a team focused on drivability and safety, working in a collaborative and supportive environment built on our core values: customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste.
   

  

 If you join our team, our relationship will be built on mutual trust, respect, and continuous learning. I see leadership as a partnership. I will challenge you to grow, and I expect you to challenge me as well. By learning from each other, we will both become better professionals and better people.
   

  

 I lead with trust, positive intent, and a lot of laughter. Creating an environment where people feel safe, motivated, and energized is important to me. I genuinely care about your health, well-being, and long-term development.
   

  

 In return, I am looking for someone who is transparent, creative, and ambitious. Someone who takes ownership, speaks up, brings new ideas, and isn't afraid to challenge established ways of working. Together, we will build a culture where innovation, accountability, and personal growth go hand in hand.
   

  

**Scania Offers**
 We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
   

  

 With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-17. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
