**We look forward to your application!**

title: Senior Platform Engineer till Handelsbanken
description:
Vill du arbeta med affärskritiska system i en komplex miljö där din erfarenhet verkligen gör skillnad? Vi söker en senior platform engineer som vill vara med och utveckla och förvalta lösningar inom kredit och finansiell risk - i nära samspel mellan verksamhet och IT.
   

  

**Ditt team**
 Hos oss sitter IT och verksamhet tillsammans, vilket skapar korta beslutsvägar och god förståelse för affären. Teamet består av flera kompetenser, bland annat utvecklare, analytiker, APO och Team Coach.
   

  

 Vi värdesätter innovation, kunskapsdelning och ett öppet klimat där alla bidrar till teamets gemensamma leverans. Vi arbetar agilt tillsammans med ytterligare fyra team där vi gemensamt ansvarar för utveckling och förvaltning.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som senior plattformstekniker ser vi att du har god teknisk förståelse och är van att felsöka, hitta och åtgärda tekniska fel i stora och komplexa system. Du är en del av förvaltningen och hanterar den dagliga driften, vilket också kan komma att innebära beredskap utanför arbetstid.
   

  

 En viktig del av rollen är att säkerställa stabila leveranser och vidareutveckla befintliga lösningar. Du är duktig på att dokumentera lösningar och upprätthålla en god struktur vid systemförvaltning.
   

  

 Du bidrar med din erfarenhet och tekniska kompetens i tätt samarbete med teamet och verksamheten för att skapa effektiva och hållbara lösningar. Rollen innebär att arbeta i en miljö med stora datamängder, tydliga deadlines och höga krav på kvalitet. Du förväntas också bidra till förbättringar i arbetssätt, dela med dig av din kunskap och vara delaktig i att driva teamet framåt.
   

  

 Teamen arbetar tvärfunktionellt och här finns goda möjligheter att även arbeta med ren utveckling och bredda din kunskap inom finansdomänen.
   

  

**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som är en erfaren utvecklare med ett stort teknikintresse och har en nyfiken inställning. Du trivs i en miljö där du får kombinera utveckling med förvaltning och där komplexa system är en del av vardagen.
   

  

 Vi ser gärna att du har:
   

  

* Flera års erfarenhet av utveckling i system med stora datamängder, gärna inom bank eller finans
* Högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet
* God förmåga att kommunicera obehindrat både i skrift och tal på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift


 Teknisk kompetens:
   

  

* Du förstår och tycker om teknik och har lätt att kommunicera med IT såväl som verksamhet
* Du har vana att arbeta som plattformstekniker inkl. förvaltning


 Meriterande:
   

  

* SAS 9.4 plattform med grid, SAS Macro samt utveckling i DI Studio.
* SQL och Shell-script
* Databaser som Db2 LUW och MS SQL Server
* Erfarenhet av större SAS-miljöer, gärna på Linux och Data Warehouse
* Erfarenhet av att leda förvaltningsarbete.


 Du gillar att förstå hur saker faktiskt hänger ihop och är inte rädd för att sätta dig in i komplexa system. Du jobbar metodiskt, samarbetar naturligt med andra och drivs av att hitta lösningar som fungerar i praktiken Du är nyfiken och proaktiv i utmaningar som uppstår.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
*På grund av semestertider kan rekryteringsprocessen ta lite längre tid än vanligt, och återkoppling kan därför dröja något.*
 Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.
   

  

 Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.

title: UI Artist (12-month contract)
description:
### **General Information**

**Locations**: Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden
  

Role ID
215346
Worker Type
Temporary - with Benefits (EU & Malaysia)
Studio/Department
EA Studios - DICE Stockholm
Work Model
Hybrid
### **Description & Requirements**

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
*As we do not have a relocation/immigration budget, we’re unable to consider candidates based outside of Sweden.*  

Battlefield is a storied franchise renowned for uncompromising combat gameplay and all-out warfare, for over two decades. 100 million players and 5 billion hours played later, Battlefield Studios is defining the future of the first-person shooter with the biggest launch in franchise history with Battlefield 6, and a new era beginning with Battlefield REDSEC.
United under the banner of Battlefield Studios, 4 world-class teams across Criterion, DICE, Motive, and Ripple Effect have come together to focus on the future of the franchise, a connected Battlefield universe filled with immersive experiences built on our unique DNA.  

LET’S PUSH THINGS FORWARD  

DICE is a creative studio with offices in Stockholm and Gothenburg. We believe in the power of inclusion and welcome game creators from all backgrounds to collaborate with us as we unlock the potential for the future of Battlefield!  

We’re always pushing to be at the forefront of creative entertainment - blending digital art, design, and technology to push boundaries. Our collaborative culture is fueled by passion, driving innovation and making a positive difference for our players and community.  

At DICE, your ideas matter. We offer an inclusive space where you can thrive, be yourself, and grow alongside a team dedicated to making a meaningful impact to the world of gaming.  

We’re all-in on the future and our most ambitious Battlefield yet. Want to be part of something special? Read on. **What we are looking for**
DICE is seeking a **UI Artist** to report directly to the Lead UI Artist. The ideal candidate will take UX wireframes and translate them into visual UI mockups, delivering end-to-end features while adhering to and maintaining our design system. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, creating high-quality UI art assets and reliably estimating and delivering production work on time. **Key Responsibilities*** Translate UX wireframes into clear, compelling UI art mockups aligned with visual design goals.
* Produce high-quality UI art assets that are consistent with established art direction and follow approved visual benchmarks.
* Maintain and contribute to the UI design system, ensuring visual consistency, scalability, and UI asset integrity across the game experience.
* Deliver end-to-end UI features, taking work from initial visual concepts through to production and engine implementation.
* Estimate time and scope accurately for your tasks, delivering quality work on schedule and within budget.
* Work directly in Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator to design screen layouts, iconography, and visual components.
* Export and optimize production-ready UI art for the game engine, ensuring assets meet technical specs and design intent.
* Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, engineers, and the lead artist to iteratively refine UI art based on feedback from team members.

 **Skills & Qualifications*** Minimum of 3 years of experience in UI art for video games, with a portfolio showing strong visual design applied to interactive systems.
* Solid understanding of visual layout, typography, visual hierarchy, color theory, and UI iconography.
* Proven ability to work with UX wireframes and translate functional user flows into visual UI mockups.
* Demonstrated experience using software tools like Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator in a production environment.
* Good time-management skills with a track record of accurately estimating task effort and consistently meeting project deadlines.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with an open mind to feedback from leads and team members.

 **Desirable / Bonus Skills*** Ability to create animated comps, motion graphics, and interactive prototypes using Figma Prototypes, Figma Motion, or After Effects to bring UI elements to life.
* Experience using 3D tools like Blender for the purposes of producing high quality 2D art.
* Prior experience implementing, testing, and optimizing assets directly inside a game engine.
* Experience working on first-person shooters and/or familiarity with the Battlefield franchise.


Formal education or specific degrees are not required; demonstrated experience and a strong portfolio are the primary qualifications for this role.  

  

  

***About Electronic Arts***
We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.  

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.  

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Digital Merchandiser – Skapa innehåll som inspirerar miljontals hemmafixare
description:
Vill du vara med och skapa en av Nordens bästa e-handelsupplevelser?


På Byggmax har vi miljontals besökare varje månad och en e-handel som är avgörande för vår affär. Nu söker vi en Digital Merchandiser som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för innehållet och kundupplevelsen i våra digitala kanaler. Du kommer att säkerställa att rätt budskap, kampanjer och inspiration möter rätt kund vid rätt tillfälle, alltid med målet att skapa en enklare köpupplevelse och öka försäljningen.


Det här är en roll för dig som gillar att kombinera kreativitet med analys och som drivs av att ständigt förbättra den digitala kundresan.


**Forma framtidens e-handelsupplevelse**


Som Digital Merchandiser ansvarar du för det kommersiella innehållet på våra sajter: från idé och planering till publicering, uppföljning och optimering. Du arbetar datadrivet och använder insikter från kundbeteende, försäljning och trender för att skapa innehåll som engagerar, inspirerar och konverterar. Du blir en del av vårt e-handelsteam i Stockholm och rapporterar till Online Manager.


I rollen samarbetar du nära marknadsavdelningen, SEO, inköp, UX och utveckling för att säkerställa att våra sajter utvecklas i linje med både kundernas behov och våra affärsmål. Du får stort utrymme att testa nya idéer, utforska hur AI kan stärka både arbetssätt och kundupplevelse samt bidra till utvecklingen av framtidens e-handel.


Tillsammans bygger vi en kundupplevelse som gör det både enklare och roligare att fixa hemma.


**Dina arbetsuppgifter:**


* Ansvara för merchandising och innehåll på våra sajter i Sverige, Norge, Finland och Danmark.
* Säkerställa att rätt innehåll, erbjudanden och kampanjer visas på rätt plats vid rätt tidpunkt.
* Planera, skapa, publicera och optimera innehåll som driver trafik, engagemang och försäljning.
* Utveckla kundresan genom datadriven analys, UX-insikter och kontinuerliga A/B-tester.
* Säkerställa att innehållet följer Byggmax varumärke, tonalitet och grafiska profil.
* Projektleda innehållsinitiativ från brief till lansering.
* Följa upp resultat och identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter genom analys av KPI:er, kundbeteende och konvertering.
* Hålla dig uppdaterad kring nya trender inom digital handel, AI och kundupplevelse.

**Vi tror att du**


* Har erfarenhet av e-handel och digital merchandising.
* Är van att arbeta datadrivet och fatta beslut baserat på analys.
* Har ett starkt intresse för UX, CRO och digital kundupplevelse.
* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta i CMS.
* Är strukturerad, självgående och trivs med många kontaktytor.
* Gillar att ta initiativ och drivs av att ständigt förbättra både kundupplevelsen och affären.
* Är en skicklig skribent och kan skriva tydlig och engagerande copy på svenska.

Hos Byggmax får du arbeta med en av Nordens största e-handelssajter och vara med och påverka miljontals kundmöten varje år. Vi gillar att experimentera och att testa nya idéer och satsar stort på AI, personalisering och digital utveckling.


Du blir en del av ett engagerat e-handelsteam där vi hjälper varandra, tar ansvar och hela tiden strävar efter att skapa den bästa kundupplevelsen.


På Byggmax tror vi på styrkan i olika perspektiv och erfarenheter. Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrunder och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att utvecklas, växa och bidra med din kompetens.


Anställningsform: Heltid, provanställning tillämpas


Placeringsort: Byggmax huvudkontor, Lindhagensgatan 112, Stockholm (T-bana Stadshagen). Vi erbjuder hybridarbete med en kombination av kontorsarbete och distansarbete som ger både samarbete och flexibilitet i vardagen.


Ansök med ditt CV och besvara våra urvalsfrågor. Skicka gärna din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast den 31 augusti.


Välkommen till Byggmax – tillsammans bygger vi framtiden!


**Några av våra medarbetare**
-----------------------------


Charlotte Lotta Westerlind
Regionchef, Byggmax region Väst
*"Det finns ett glödande engagemang hos alla i Byggmax!"*
Farshad Shahrestani
Platschef Byggmax butik
*"Jag har vunnit på lotto som får jobba på Byggmax!"*
Anders Lindberg
Säkerhet och processansvarig
*"Jag trivs på Byggmax för att jag har så roligt på jobbet!"*
Disa Malmgren
Butiksmedarbetare Byggmax Luleå
*"Jag har världens bästa chef som är omtänksam och härlig!"*
**Vi har riktigt bra förmåner**
-------------------------------


* Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter
* Friskvård och balans i livet
* Personalrabatt i flera av våra koncernbolag
* Stark entreprenöriell anda
* Värderingsstyrd kultur
* Pensionsavsättningar
**Om företaget**
----------------


Alla hemmasnickare ska kunna förverkliga sina byggdrömmar, det tycker i alla fall vi på Byggmax. Oavsett om det handlar om inomhus-, utomhus- eller trädgårdsprojekt. Därför jobbar alla Byggmaxare mot samma mål: att ge dessa hemmasnickare både råd och möjlighet till det!


Byggmax har totalt över 190 butiker fördelat i Sverige, Norge och Finland. Utöver de fysiska butikerna finns även en ständigt växande e-handel. Sedan starten 1993 har Byggmax haft som affärsidé att vara det bästa och billigaste alternativet för hobbysnickare och proffs som vill köpa byggmaterial av bra kvalitet. Vi har gått från att vara en ettrig uppstickare till att bli en av Sveriges största byggmaterialkedjor. Med hjälp av ständiga förbättringar, löpande effektiviseringar och en förändringsbenägen företagskultur har bolaget blivit ett av branschens lönsammaste. I koncernen Byggmax Group ingår även Skånska Byggvaror, Buildor, Right Price Tiles och Næstved Lavpristræ.


Varmt välkommen till Byggmax, både som kund och som potentiell medarbetare!


TOMTOM


AnsvarJag står för det jag tänker, säger och gör. Jag håller det jag lovat och agerar alltid utifrån Byggmax bästa.


Positiv attitydJag väljer att alltid se möjligheter och lösningar. Med mitt positiva sätt att tänka ger jag energi till laget och våra kunder. Allt är möjligt!


RoligtJag ser alla som fantastiska och sprider glädje genom att bjuda på mig själv och mitt leende. Då får vi alla kul tillsammans!!


RespektJag ser, lyssnar och försöker förstå alla i min omgivning. Genom att behandla alla andra som jag själv vill bli behandlad bygger vi starka och bra relationer.


EngagemangJag bjuder på mig själv och ger det lilla extra. Jag är aktivt delaktig och visar ett genuint intresse för både kollegor och kunder.


TillsammansTillsammans prioriterar vi helheten och pratar direkt med varandra.


100%Jag gör alltid mitt bästa och är närvarande Vi ska vara världens bästa bygghandel.

title: Senior UX-strateg och UX/UI-designer till vår IT-enhet
description:
**Din roll och arbetsuppgifter**
--------------------------------


Som senior UX-strateg och UX/UI-designer på Skogsstyrelsen kommer du att få en central och viktig roll i att säkerställa att vi når våra mål med att skapa effektiva och användarvänliga digitala lösningar. Du kommer att finnas på IT-enheten där du arbetar i team tillsammans med våra utvecklare men samspelar nära med användare i alla olika delar av vår verksamhet.

**I din roll som UX-strateg och UX/UI-designer kommer du bland annat:**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

* Ansvara för att utveckla och driva myndighetens arbete inom användarcentrerad design, inklusive omvärldsbevakning och kompetensutveckling
* Planera, genomföra och analysera användarundersökningar för att förstå behov och beteenden
* Ta fram, förvalta och kravställa designsystem inklusive användarupplevelse och gränssnitt
* Samverka med team, ta fram prototyper och säkerställa tillgängliga och kvalitativa digitala lösningar

**Du kommer även att:**
-----------------------

* Delta i Skogsstyrelsens olika innovationsprojekt och bidra med UX-kompetens
* Arbeta med andra typer av projekt inom myndigheten utifrån aktuella behov

**Kvalifikationer och dina egenskaper**
---------------------------------------


Vi söker dig som har:

* Minst 5 år av UX/UI-design samt arbete som UX-strateg, inklusive ansvar för designsystem
* Stark kompetens inom användarcentrerade metoder, tjänstedesign och arbete i agila team (SCRUM)
* Mycket goda verktygskunskaper, särskilt i Figma och Useberry, samt erfarenhet av prototyping och analys
* Djup kunskap inom tillgänglighet (WCAG), relevanta regelverk (tillexempel GDPR) samt erfarenhet av Angular Material
* Förmåga att driva utveckling och utbildning inom området, arbeta strukturerat samt kommunicerar väl på svenska i tal och skrift


Meriterande kunskaper:

* Arbete på myndighet och insikter i vad den statliga värdegrunden innebär
* Arbetat med geografiska informationssystem (GIS) och visualisering av data i GIS.
* Kunskap om processer och tekniker kring ärendehantering både som handläggarstöd och som e-tjänst

**Personliga egenskaper**
-------------------------


Vi söker dig som är strukturerad, analytisk och nyfiken och brinner för att sätta användaren i centrum. Du har ett genuint intresse för både design, teknik och människor. Vidare är du kommunikativ och trivs med både arbetsuppgifter som kräver samarbete och självständigt arbete. Du är lyhörd och har lätt att anpassa dig till olika situationer för att sätta dig in i olika verksamheters unika utmaningar. Som UX/UI-designer är du modig och kan stå upp för att driva viktiga frågor kring betydelsen av att bygga digitala lösningar som utgår från användarnas behov.

**Placering**
-------------


Placeringsort är Jönköping i första hand men annan ort där vi har kontor kan diskuteras. Placering på annan ort än Jönköping innebär tjänsteresor till Jönköping ett par gånger i månaden.


Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-08-30


Har du frågor finns gruppchef Helena Tallberg på plats from 2026-08-10, telefon 010-172 18 38


Det här är Skogsstyrelsen Skogsstyrelsen är en myndighet för frågor som rör skog. Vår vision är Skog till nytta för alla. Vi arbetar för att landets skogar ska vårdas och brukas så att skogen ger uthållig god avkastning samtidigt som biologisk mångfald och andra miljövärden bevaras. Vi arbetar också med att öka medvetandet om skogens betydelse för samhället. Vi finns i hela landet med kontor från Pajala i norr till Hässleholm i söder. Huvudkontoret finns i Jönköping. Vår geografiska spridning gör att våra arbetssätt till stor del är digitala, även resor förekommer för vissa av våra befattningar. Tillsammans arbetar vi för att vår myndighet ska vara en vänlig arbetsplats där alla medarbetare trivs, utvecklas och vill stanna kvar. Din introduktion kompletteras med utbildningar som stärker dig i din roll på Skogsstyrelsen och som statsanställd. Vår medarbetar- och ledaridé har gemensamma värdeord: gemenskap, respekt, ansvar och nyfikenhet. Dessa kompletteras i vårt dagliga arbete av den statliga värdegrunden. Vi erbjuder ett par värdefulla arbetsförmåner som kan göra stor skillnad för dig. Vi hoppas du kommer att trivas hos oss! Är du nyfiken eller har en fråga, tveka inte att höra av dig om du inte finner svar på vår hemsida: Om oss - Skogsstyrelsen samt Jobba hos oss - Skogsstyrelsen Välkommen till Skogsstyrelsen!

title: Head of Testing (AI)
description:
**Who are we?**
 At Newcode.ai, we're transforming how law firms and legal professionals harness AI for real-world impact. As part of our collaborative, high-growth team, you'll have the rare opportunity to work side-by-side with visionary founders at the bleeding edge of AI and legal innovation — shaping not just our product, but the future of legal work itself.
   

  

**Note:** 
 We believe in being transparent about what it's like to work at Newcode. As a fast-growing startup, we're building and evolving every day. That means not every process, playbook, or framework is already in place, and priorities can shift quickly.
   

  

 The people who thrive here are comfortable with ambiguity, take ownership, and don't wait for perfect direction. They are resourceful, proactive, and able to "figure it out"—solving problems, creating structure where needed, and helping build the company as they go. If you are good with this then, great! Keep reading to learn more.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As Head of Testing, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution of product testing across Newcode. You will develop the frameworks, processes, and standards needed to evaluate our AI-powered products, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure we deliver reliable, high-quality solutions to our customers.
   

  

 This role requires someone who understands both
 **software testing and AI product evaluation** 
 — someone who can think critically about how AI systems should be tested, measured, and improved.
   

  

 You will work closely with Engineering and Legal Engineering to establish a world-class testing function.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute Newcode's overall testing strategy across AI-powered products

title: UI Artist (12-month contract)
description:
**Description & Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

*As we do not have a relocation/immigration budget, we’re unable to consider candidates based outside of Sweden.*
 Battlefield is a storied franchise renowned for uncompromising combat gameplay and all-out warfare, for over two decades. 100 million players and 5 billion hours played later, Battlefield Studios is defining the future of the first-person shooter with the biggest launch in franchise history with Battlefield 6, and a new era beginning with Battlefield REDSEC.
   

  

 United under the banner of Battlefield Studios, 4 world-class teams across Criterion, DICE, Motive, and Ripple Effect have come together to focus on the future of the franchise, a connected Battlefield universe filled with immersive experiences built on our unique DNA.
   

  

 LET’S PUSH THINGS FORWARD
   

  

 DICE is a creative studio with offices in Stockholm and Gothenburg. We believe in the power of inclusion and welcome game creators from all backgrounds to collaborate with us as we unlock the potential for the future of Battlefield!
   

  

 We’re always pushing to be at the forefront of creative entertainment - blending digital art, design, and technology to push boundaries. Our collaborative culture is fueled by passion, driving innovation and making a positive difference for our players and community.
   

  

 At DICE, your ideas matter. We offer an inclusive space where you can thrive, be yourself, and grow alongside a team dedicated to making a meaningful impact to the world of gaming.
   

  

 We’re all-in on the future and our most ambitious Battlefield yet. Want to be part of something special? Read on.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 DICE is seeking a
 **UI Artist** 
 to report directly to the Lead UI Artist. The ideal candidate will take UX wireframes and translate them into visual UI mockups, delivering end-to-end features while adhering to and maintaining our design system. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, creating high-quality UI art assets and reliably estimating and delivering production work on time.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Translate UX wireframes into clear, compelling UI art mockups aligned with visual design goals.
* Produce high-quality UI art assets that are consistent with established art direction and follow approved visual benchmarks.
* Maintain and contribute to the UI design system, ensuring visual consistency, scalability, and UI asset integrity across the game experience.
* Deliver end-to-end UI features, taking work from initial visual concepts through to production and engine implementation.
* Estimate time and scope accurately for your tasks, delivering quality work on schedule and within budget.
* Work directly in Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator to design screen layouts, iconography, and visual components.
* Export and optimize production-ready UI art for the game engine, ensuring assets meet technical specs and design intent.
* Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, engineers, and the lead artist to iteratively refine UI art based on feedback from team members.


**Skills & Qualifications**
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in UI art for video games, with a portfolio showing strong visual design applied to interactive systems.
* Solid understanding of visual layout, typography, visual hierarchy, color theory, and UI iconography.
* Proven ability to work with UX wireframes and translate functional user flows into visual UI mockups.
* Demonstrated experience using software tools like Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator in a production environment.
* Good time-management skills with a track record of accurately estimating task effort and consistently meeting project deadlines.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with an open mind to feedback from leads and team members.


**Desirable / Bonus Skills**
* Ability to create animated comps, motion graphics, and interactive prototypes using Figma Prototypes, Figma Motion, or After Effects to bring UI elements to life.
* Experience using 3D tools like Blender for the purposes of producing high quality 2D art.
* Prior experience implementing, testing, and optimizing assets directly inside a game engine.
* Experience working on first-person shooters and/or familiarity with the Battlefield franchise.


 Formal education or specific degrees are not required; demonstrated experience and a strong portfolio are the primary qualifications for this role.
   

  

**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: UX/UI Designer – PostNord App, Solna
description:
Vill du göra vardagen enklare för våra nordiska användare?
   

  

 Vill du designa produkter som används av miljontals människor varje månad – och göra vardagen lite enklare för kunder i hela Norden?
   

  

 Vi söker nu en UX/UI Designer till vårt Consumer Apps‑team, med fokus på PostNord Appen som idag används brett i Sverige, Danmark och Finland - och snart även i Norge. Här får du arbeta med en produkt där varje detalj du designar gör skillnad.
   

  

 Som UX/UI Designer hos oss arbetar du hands-on genom hela designprocessen - från att förstå problem och användarbehov till att ta fram lösningar som implementeras i produkten.
   

  

 Rollen har en tydlig tyngd på UI och visuellt hantverk. Samtidigt handlar arbetet mycket om att navigera komplexitet – förstå affärsregler, samordna med stakeholders och driva initiativ framåt i organisationen.
   

  

**Du Kommer**
* Ta del av ägandeskap för design av konkreta flows, funktioner och gränssnitt
* Skapa wireframes, interaktionsdesign, prototyper och färdig UI
* Säkerställa hög kvalitet, tillgänglighet och konsistens i leveranser
* Arbeta nära utvecklare för att säkerställa att design är genomförbar
* Kollaborera med produktägare och stakeholders för att driva lösningar framåt
* Du blir en viktig del i att realisera och vidareutveckla designarbetet tillsammans med UX Lead.


**Vi Tror Att Du**
* Har erfarenhet av att designa digitala produkter för native appar (UX/UI)
* Är trygg i att arbeta självständigt, men också öppen för feedback och vägledning
* Har ett starkt öga för UI, detaljer och visuellt hantverk
* Har djup kunskap i Figma (inkl. komponenter, variabler eller liknande arbetssätt)
* Förstår hur man designar robusta flöden med olika states och edge cases
* Har god förståelse för både UX och UI – och hur de samverkar i praktiken
* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta nära utvecklare och navigera tekniska begränsningar
* Har kunskap om WCAG och tillgänglighet
* Är självgående och driver arbete framåt i en komplex miljö
* Är stark i stakeholder management och kommunikation


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid inställning och arbetssätt. Vi tror att du gillar att lösa problem, samarbeta och ta dig an komplexa utmaningar – snarare än att enbart fokusera på “nya features” eller stora redesigns.
   

  

**Extra Viktigt i Rollen**
* Förståelse för plattformsspecifika designprinciper (iOS / Android) och deras begränsningar
* Förmåga att motivera designbeslut utifrån dessa principer
* Erfarenhet av designsystem – du behöver inte äga ett, men ska kunna arbeta och bidra i ett
* Förmåga att skapa och arbeta med komponenter och strukturer i större skalor


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av större organisationer eller komplexa produktmiljöer
* Erfarenhet av mobilappar med hög användarvolym
* Intresse för hur AI kan användas för att effektivisera design- eller arbetsflöden
* Erfarenhet av verktyg/arbetsflöden som Jira, design tokens eller liknande


**Vad Du Kan Förvänta Dig**
* Arbeta med en produkt med miljontals användare i Norden
* Vara en del av ett team där design spelar en viktig roll i produktutvecklingen
* Samarbeta tätt med utveckling och produkt i vardagen
* Möjlighet att påverka både detaljer och helhetsupplevelse


**Vi gör vardagen enklare**
 PostNord är den ledande leverantören av kommunikations- och logistiklösningar till, från och inom Norden. Vi säkerställer postservicen till privatpersoner och företag i Sverige och Danmark. Vi strävar efter att göra vardagen enklare och mer hållbar för alla som bor och arbetar i Norden. Vi är ansvarstagande, modiga och engagerade, och leder effektivt förändring oavsett om vi leder oss själva eller andra. Vi uppmuntrar lagarbete, uppriktighet och positiva relationer på arbetsplatsen. Vi bygger vidare på våra framgångar och lär oss av både kollegor och misstag. Människor med olika bakgrund arbetar hos oss. Du kommer därför vara en del av en arbetsplats med stor mångfald, vilket bidrar till bättre resultat för verksamheten. Besök oss på www.postnord.com.
   

  

**Ansök**
 Vad väntar du på? Välkommen med din ansökan! Urval sker löpande, men på grund av semestertider kan återkoppling komma att dröja något – vi planerar att tidigast återkomma som
 **tidigast i mitten på augusti.**
 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Want to Shape How Millions Pay on FINN, Blocket & other Nordic Marketplaces?**
**THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL
   

  

 You?** 
 A strategic product leader with a deep understanding of modern payment ecosystems. You thrive on navigating complex partnerships and driving cross-functional alignment to build seamless, secure financial experiences.
   

  

**Role?** 
 Product Manager on our Payment team, owning the vision, strategy, and execution of our payment solutions across our brands, bridging between external payment partners, technical delivery teams, and internal business stakeholders to scale our transactional capabilities.
   

  

**Company?** 
 Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics go to find what they need, whether it's second-hand goods, a job, a home or a way to move.
   

  

**Location? J** 
 oin us in our Oslo or Stockholm office where you’ll have the flexibility to work remotely 3 days a week.
   

  

**Why us?** 
 This is your chance to lead a fast-scaling transactional platform that directly impacts millions of Nordic users. You drive high-visibility partnerships, cultivate an evolving team culture, and experience dedicated personal and professional growth in a highly collaborative environment.
   

  

*Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!*
**WHO ARE YOU?**
* Proven experience building and leading digital products from concept to execution, with a deep understanding of the payments ecosystem and transactional models.
* You possess the influence and negotiation skills required to manage external payment providers and fintech partners, ensuring mutually beneficial, high-performing collaborations, as well as internal vertical stakeholders.
* You’re adaptable and can pivot smoothly when priorities shift based on business results and help your team navigate changes with steadiness.
* You combine vision with pragmatism: You have the ability to translate a 5-year vision into clear, actionable short-term wins that keep the momentum going.
* High professional-level fluency in English: You effortlessly manage internal stakeholders, translating complex technical constraints to business leaders and aligning business objectives with engineering realities.


**WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?**
 As our Product Manager for the Payments Team, you own the core transactional experiences that define our marketplaces. Your main objective is to lead the team in building the best transactional and payment solutions as a foundational core layer. You manage the balance between ambitious forward-thinking strategies and continuous, value-driven software delivery
   

  

**Your Day-to-Day & Key Projects**
* Lead the continuous development of our new digital wallet and accelerate the cross-border scaling of our escrow solutions beyond Norway into our other Nordic markets.
* Evaluate and direct negotiations with major external payment vendors and financial partners to optimize our capabilities.
* Guide a dedicated squad of developers and UX designers, contributing to a structured, psychologically safe, and high-performing team culture.
* Interface closely with leadership across our commercial verticals to ensure the payments roadmap directly facilitates broader business goals.


 What success looks like in 6 months to one year:
   

  

* You have built deep trust with the product team, smoothed out cross-location collaboration dynamics, established a consistent short-term delivery cadence, and assumed ownership of key external partner relationships.
* You have seamlessly scaled the payment/escrow solutions across multiple Nordic markets and established a sustainable, predictable product delivery structure that bridges long-term vision with operational realities.


**A Few Words From Product Director, Lene Graff Christensen**
*"Hi, I am Lene Graff Christiansen, Product Director of Marketplace Platforms. The Payments team builds the transactional heartbeat of our marketplace—and we are looking for a strong product mind to help us scale it.
   

  

 We are a collaborative and curious team that values deep ownership and turning bold visions into measurable results. I am looking for someone who will confidently own this domain, bring fresh industry insights to the table, and challenge our current way of thinking. If you are ready to tackle complex payment challenges, this is a fantastic opportunity to broaden your expertise, grow as a product leader, and make a massive impact on Vend’s future."*
**GOT YOUR ATTENTION?** 
 Let us hear from you! Make sure to apply by August 19th. You don't need to write an application letter, we are more interested in your answers to the questions in the application form.
   

  

**QUESTIONS?**
 Product Director Lene Graff Christiansen is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role. Lene is best reached by e-mail: lene.graff[at]vend.com

title: King's AI/ML & Data Science Talent Pool
description:
**Craft:**
 Data, Analytics & Strategy
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Join King’s AI/ML & Data Science Talent Pool!**
 At King, we’re always interested in connecting with talented people across AI, Machine Learning, Data Science and Analytics who are passionate about using data and technology to create better experiences for millions of players.
   

  

 Whether you’re an Associate, Mid-level, Senior, Principal or Lead Data Scientist, AI/ML Engineer, Research Engineer or Product Analyst, we’d love to hear from you. By joining our Talent Pool, you’ll be considered for future opportunities across our game teams and central AI/ML and Data Science teams. If your background aligns with a role, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will get in touch to discuss it with you.
   

  

**What We’re Typically Looking For**
 Our teams work across areas including applied AI research, player behaviour modelling, personalisation, recommendations, experimentation, decision automation, game and product analytics, content optimisation, forecasting and production ML systems.
   

  

 While every role requires a different combination of skills, we often look for people with experience in:
   

  

* Applying data science, machine learning, statistics or analytics to solve player, product or business challenges.
* Developing models, experiments, analyses or data products that improve player experience, personalisation, content, decision-making or business performance.
* Taking work from exploration and prototyping through to implementation, production or measurable product impact.
* Building or working with reliable data and ML pipelines, evaluation approaches and scalable systems.
* Bringing expertise in one or more areas such as machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, optimisation, deep learning, reinforcement learning, generative AI or data visualisation.
* Using relevant tools and technologies for your field. Depending on the role, these might include Python, SQL, Spark, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, cloud platforms, dashboards, experimentation platforms or ML pipelines. We don’t expect candidates to have experience with all of these.
* Collaborating with Engineering, Product, Game Design, UX and other disciplines to turn opportunities into practical, player-focused solutions.
* Communicating complex ideas clearly through analysis, documentation, model evaluations, prototypes, dashboards or presentations.


 We welcome people from both academia and industry; from PhD students and early-career professionals to experienced specialists and technical leaders.
   

  

 Your experience might come from gaming, consumer technology, entertainment, e-commerce, fintech, advertising, research or another data-rich environment. What matters most is your curiosity, collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for solving complex problems and delivering meaningful impact.
   

  

**Why King?**
 At King, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to games and experiences enjoyed by millions of players around the world. You could work with large-scale data, explore emerging technologies, help bring models into production or use analytics to inform decisions that directly affect our players.
   

  

 Our AI/ML, Data Science and Analytics teams work in collaborative, cross-functional environments where curiosity, experimentation, technical excellence and practical impact are encouraged.
   

  

 Whether you’re passionate about applied AI research, ML engineering, product analytics, experimentation or scalable ML systems, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution while continuing to develop your craft.
   

  

***Interested?***
 Submit your profile to our Talent Pool!
   

  

 Every profile submitted is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. If your skills and experience align with the types of AI/ML, Data Science or Analytics opportunities we hire for, we’ll add your profile to our Talent Pool and may reach out if a suitable opportunity becomes available.
   

  

 If we don’t believe your background currently aligns with these opportunities, we’ll let you know and won’t progress your profile into the Talent Pool at this time. You’re always welcome to apply for other opportunities at King that match your skills and experience.
   

  

 We appreciate your interest in King and look forward to connecting with you if the right opportunity arises.
   

  

**About King**
 With a mission of
 *Making the World Playful* 
 , King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as
 *Farm Heroes Saga* 
 . King games are played by more than 200 million monthly active users. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

description:
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses - including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others - rely on Sinch's Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.
 



  





 Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.
 



  





 At Sinch we "Dream Big", "Win Together", "Keep it simple", and "Make it Happen". These values are our foundation!
 



  





**DESCRIPTION** 




  





 Sinch is on a multi-year journey to responsibly scale AI across Enterprise IT (EIT). We're looking for a Specialist AI Technical Product Manager to take ownership of core AI capabilities as part of the EIT domain to ensure AI is safe, effective, and enterprise-ready.
 



  





 You'll partner closely with our central AI Function (responsible for end-user experience, including agent configuration and design) and act as the bridge to Infrastructure, End-User Support, Security, and other IT teams. You'll define, deliver, and continuously improve the technical products, integrations, and operating model that enable AI at scale.
 



  





 This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid) and reports to the VP, Business Operations EIT.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* Own the AI Product Strategy: Define and manage the roadmap for enterprise AI capabilities, including connectors, LLM services, governance tools, and guardrails.
* Deliver Secure Integrations: Design and implement AI connectors for platforms like Microsoft 365, Slack, Jira, SAP, and data warehouses, ensuring performance and resilience.
* Build Knowledge Foundations: Set standards for data ingestion, classification, enrichment, and retention to power AI systems while protecting sensitive information.
* Drive AI Quality & Safety: Define success metrics, run A/B tests, and establish monitoring for drift, hallucinations, and compliance.
* Ensure Security & Compliance: Collaborate with Security, Legal, and Privacy teams to meet ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR requirements; create incident response playbooks.
* Enable Adoption: Develop support playbooks, training programs, and clear roles across IT and business units to scale AI responsibly.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




  




* **Education** 
 : Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred).
* **Experience** 
 : 3+ years in Product Management or Technical Program roles delivering AI/ML or data-driven products in enterprise environments.
* **Security & Compliance** 
 : Strong grounding in data privacy, DLP, PII handling, and audit requirements.
* **Ways of Working** 
 : Comfortable with Agile/Scrum; able to write clear PRDs and architecture diagrams.
* **Soft Skills** 
 : Excellent communication and stakeholder management; proven ability to influence and lead change.
* **Nice to Have** 
 : ITIL v4 and cloud certifications.



  





**Technical Expertise** 
 :
 



  




* Hands-on with LLMs and platforms like OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock (Google Agentspace is a plus).
* Familiarity with RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt management, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience building secure APIs/connectors (REST/GraphQL) and working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Knowledge of enterprise IT systems (Microsoft 365, Jira, Slack) and identity/access management (Azure AD, Okta).



  





 Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in
 **English** 
 .
 



  





 Must currently reside in and be eligible for employment in Stockholm, Sweden.
 



 Relocation and visa sponsorship are not available for this role
 



  





**OUR HIRING PROCESS** 




  





 We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.
 



  





 We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!
 



  





**Salary** 
 :
 



  





 The monthly base salary for this position is between 65 000 SEK to 85 000 SEK. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.

title: IT-tekniker
description:
Vill du arbeta i en bred och varierad IT-roll där du är nära verksamheten och får lösa problem som verkligen gör skillnad i människors vardag? Silex är ett svenskt, världsledande företag inom MEMS-teknologi och en viktig partner till några av världens främsta teknikföretag. Efter vår nyliga börsnotering befinner vi oss i en tillväxtfas med fokus på innovation, utveckling och framtidens teknik.
   

  

 Vi söker en IT-tekniker som, tillsammans med teamet, vill ta ett helhetsansvar för allt från daglig support och felsökning till förbättringsarbete och utveckling av IT-teamet. Du får en varierad roll där du arbetar nära verksamheten och bidrar till en stabil, säker och modern IT-miljö som stöttar medarbetare och företagets fortsatta tillväxt. Vill du veta mer om Silex? Läs mer här.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som IT-tekniker ansvarar du för att leverera stabil och effektiv support till hela verksamheten på ca 500 anställda. Du arbetar i en miljö där tillgänglighet, säkerhet och användarupplevelse är avgörande och du hanterar allt från enklare supportärenden till mycket komplexa problem.
   

  

 Huvudfokus ligger på användarstöd, men rollen är bred och innefattar även administration av IT-miljöer samt projekt- och förbättringsarbete för våra system och arbetssätt. Du driver ärenden självständigt från start till lösning och säkerställer hög servicenivå.
   

  

 IT-landskapet är en blandning av kontorsmiljö och produktionsmiljö med renrum där IT-utrustning interagerar med OT-utrustning. Vi är Microsoft-intensiva och servermiljön är en hybrid med on-prem och molntjänster. Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med kollegor inom IT, externa leverantörer och verksamheten i stort.
   

  

 Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar bland annat att:
   

  

* Ge first- och second line support via ärendehanteringssystem.
* Felsöka och lösa problem kopplade till datorer, skrivare, nätverk, operativsystem och applikationer.
* Installera, konfigurera och underhålla datorer, mobila enheter och annan IT-utrustning.
* Administrera användarkonton, behörigheter och säkerhetsinställningar i Active Directory/Entra och Microsoft 365.
* Arbeta med enhetshantering via Intune samt hantering av GPO:er.
* Dokumentera ärenden och bidra till kunskapsdatabas.
* Delta i IT-projekt, exempelvis utrullning av hård- och mjukvara.
* Ansvara för onboarding av nyanställda, inklusive konton, utrustning och behörigheter.


 Arbetet omfattar hela IT-miljön, från hårdvara och mjukvara till kontohantering och informationssäkerhet och sker på plats i Järfälla.
   

  

**Teamet**
 Vår nästa IT-tekniker blir en del av IT-avdelningens Service team som består av ett mindre, sammansvetsat team med en IT-supporttekniker, en infrastrukturtekniker och en arbetsledare. I teamet finns ett nära samarbete där man stöttar varandra och delar kunskap.
   

  

 Arbetet kännetecknas av öppen dialog, prestigelöshet och gemensamt ansvar för att leverera hög kvalitet till verksamheten. Du rapporterar till IT Service Manager och arbetar i en miljö där samarbete och initiativförmåga är centralt.
   

  

**Vi söker dig med:**
* 5 års erfarenhet av IT-support och arbete med IT-infrastruktur.
* Erfarenhet av first- och second line support.
* God kunskap inom IT-hårdvara såsom datorer, skrivare och mobila enheter.
* Grundläggande förståelse för serverdrift, nätverk, brandvägg och VPN.
* Erfarenhet av Active Directory/Entra, Intune, Exchange och Microsoft 365 molntjänster.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.


 Därtill ser vi det som meriterande om du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av informationssäkerhet, ex Zero trust
* Kunskap inom telefonihantering (MDM)


 För att lyckas hos oss tror vi att du är serviceinriktad, lösningsorienterad och prestigelös. Du är initiativtagande, flexibel och har förmågan att prioritera i en vardag med varierande arbetsuppgifter. Du trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor och har ett genuint intresse för att hjälpa andra.
   

  

**Vad vi erbjuder dig:**
* Brett och varierande arbete inom IT.
* Arbete nära verksamheten där du får göra konkret nytta varje dag.
* Möjligheter att påverka och förbättra arbetssätt och lösningar.
* Nära samarbete med engagerade och kompetenta kollegor.
* En dynamisk arbetsplats där utveckling och expansion står i fokus.


**Om Silex**
 Silex är världens största och mest avancerade renodlade MEMS-foundry med huvudkontor i Stockholm. MEMS finns i nästan all modern teknik, från personliga prylar till fordonselektronik, medicinsk övervaknings- och testutrustning.
   

  

**Övrig information:**
 Rekryteringsprocessen är pausad under semesterperioden och återupptas i mitten eller slutet av augusti. Vi återkommer därefter till dig som skickat in en ansökan.
   

  

 För att skicka in din ansökan önskar vi att du bifogar ditt CV samt svarar på några frågor. Därefter innefattar rekryteringsprocessen intervjuer, tester samt referenstagning. Vi genomför även bakgrundskontroll och drogtest innan eventuell anställning. Som arbetsgivare tillämpar vi därtill slumpmässiga alkohol- och drogtester för alla anställda.

title: Creative Lead - Visual Merchandising
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
   

  

 Visual Merchandising shapes how content looks and feels across the Spotify experience. We create the artwork, visual systems, and creative frameworks behind Spotify Playlists, Share Cards, Video Titles, Podcasts, and Audiobooks—bringing the world's largest audio platform to life for hundreds of millions of listeners every day.
   

  

 As AI transforms how creative teams imagine, develop, and produce work, we're looking for a visionary Creative Lead to define what's next. This is an opportunity to shape the future of visual storytelling at Spotify by combining world-class creative leadership with emerging technologies, ensuring every visual experience remains unmistakably Spotify while inspiring audiences around the world.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Define and evolve Spotify's global visual merchandising vision, setting the creative direction for artwork, visual systems, and brand expression across the Spotify experience.
* Lead the continued evolution of our creative workflows, identifying how AI can elevate creativity, quality, speed, and scalability while maintaining exceptional craft.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design Platform, and R&D leaders to ensure merchandising and product innovation evolve together.
* Champion a visual strategy that keeps Spotify culturally relevant across more than 180 markets while balancing global consistency with local expression.
* Establish creative principles, standards, and scalable systems that empower teams to deliver world-class visual experiences at scale.
* Build strong partnerships with internal creative teams, external agencies, illustrators, photographers, and freelance talent to expand Spotify's creative capabilities.
* Lead and develop a high-performing team of Senior Visual Designers by creating an environment built on trust, inclusion, curiosity, feedback, and creative excellence.
* Own the team's operating budget and prioritize investments that deliver meaningful creative and business impact.
* Use audience insights, experimentation, and performance data to continuously improve the effectiveness of Spotify's visual merchandising strategy.
* Represent Visual Merchandising as a trusted creative partner across Spotify, influencing senior stakeholders through thoughtful creative leadership.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have 10+ years of experience leading creative work across design, art direction, branding, editorial, advertising, or visual storytelling for a consumer-facing brand.
* You have experience building, leading, and developing exceptional creative teams while creating an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.
* You understand how emerging technologies—including generative AI—are transforming creative strategy, production, and design systems, and you're excited by the opportunities they create.
* You bring exceptional visual craft together with strategic thinking, balancing creativity, business goals, and customer needs.
* You have experience collaborating across product, design, engineering, marketing, and executive leadership teams to deliver ambitious creative outcomes.
* You are comfortable using data, experimentation, and audience insights to inform creative decisions without compromising creative quality.
* You have experience working across global markets and understand how to build creative work that respects cultural nuance while maintaining a strong global brand.
* You care deeply about mentoring others, raising the creative bar, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.
* You're naturally curious about design, music, culture, technology, and storytelling, and you're motivated by creating work that reaches millions of people every day.


 Where You Are
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Product Owner
description:
Home Career Open positions Job search article
   

  

 Product Owner
   

  

**Company**
 Telenor Sweden
   

  

 Solna 169 41 , Sweden
   

  

 Category
   

  

 IT
   

  

 Apply here
   

  

**About The Position**
**Looking for a workplace for the future?**
 At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the map for how we communicate and live our connected lives in the future.
   

  

 We are now looking for a
 **Product Owner** 
 to join our team within
 **B2C Core** 
**.**
**How You’ll Make a Difference With Us**
 As a Product Owner, you will play a key role in bridging business and technology, ensuring that development and maintenance activities deliver optimal business value.
   

  

 You will be accountable for defining the product’s direction, strategy, and ensuring a strong balance between innovation, maintenance, and reduction of technical debt. You will own and drive the product roadmap, prioritize the backlog, and secure that the team is always working on the most valuable initiatives.
   

  

**Role**
 In this role, you will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization, including business, product, and digital teams, as well as work hands-on with agile teams consisting of developers, testers, architects, and analysts. You will also participate in architectural decisions to ensure that solutions align with business needs and deliver real value. You will:
   

  

* Own and drive the product roadmap and strategy
* Prioritize and manage the product backlog
* Balance business value, innovation, maintenance, and technical debt
* Gather and clarify requirements from stakeholders across the value chain
* Define and monitor product metrics to track performance and outcomes
* Drive smaller cross-team initiatives
* Ensure compliance with policies and regulations (e.g., personal data handling)
* Escalate risks when needed according to the risk management process
* Continuously improving ways of working within the team and interfaces


 This role is central to ensuring that we deliver high-quality, impactful solutions that simplify and improve our customers’ everyday lives.
   

  

**Are you the one we’re looking for?**
 We need someone who’s always on their toes! You have a genuine desire to learn and develop so we can continue to meet our customers’ ever-changing needs – today and tomorrow.
   

  

**Must-have**
* Several years of experience working in a development and maintenance organization
* Proven ability to balance business value, financial considerations, and product priorities
* Experience working in agile environments and managing product backlogs
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills


**Nice To Have**
* Experience from telecom or digital customer journeys
* Experience working across multiple teams or driving cross-team initiatives
* Familiarity with product metrics and data-driven decision-making


 You are a collaborative and structured individual who thrives at the intersection of business and technology. You enjoy taking ownership, making decisions, and driving progress together with others.
   

  

**Our promise to you!**
*We are better together.* 
 Here, you’ll be part of a family-like and inclusive culture, built on strong shared values and leadership that empowers you with both trust and confidence. We believe in enabling each other to act and make decisions, while always having each other’s backs through ups and downs.
   

  

*We support relationships and societies.* 
 Telenor plays a vital role in the society, giving your work a greater purpose. Every day, we create value for millions of people and maintain a customer-first approach where human relationships are at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

*We make room for life.* 
 Work from home up to two days a week, if your role allows it. The rest of the time, we create magic together at the office. You also get two ‘give-me-a-break’ days per year for extra time off, and our flexible working hours help you balance your time. We support you through every stage of life with our benefit package, including collective agreements, occupational pensions, wellness allowances, and customized insurance solutions tailored to your needs.
   

  

*We invite you to a career in motion.* 
 Your development is at the center of our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours per year for you to deepen your expertise, explore new areas, and develop in your role. Through Telenor Academy and other learning initiatives, you’ll have the tools and freedom to advance your career. If you want to broaden your horizons, we are present throughout the Nordics.
   

  

**Apply today!**
 Will you take the next step in your career with us? We look forward to your application! We review applicants on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait—reach out today.
   

  

 If you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to contact the hiring manager
 **Pepe Ekholm** 
 at pepe.ekholm@telenor.se. Please note that we cannot accept applications via email.
   

  

**Good to know**
 As part of Telenor’s policy, we conduct background checks on final candidates for all recruitments.

title: Sound Designer (12-month contract)
description:
**Description & Requirements**
 Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

*As we do not have a relocation/immigration budget, we’re unable to consider candidates based outside of Sweden.*
 Battlefield is a storied franchise renowned for uncompromising combat gameplay and all-out warfare, for over two decades. 100 million players and 5 billion hours played later, Battlefield Studios is defining the future of the first-person shooter with the biggest launch in franchise history with Battlefield 6, and a new era beginning with Battlefield REDSEC.
   

  

 United under the banner of Battlefield Studios, 4 world-class teams across Criterion, DICE, Motive, and Ripple Effect have come together to focus on the future of the franchise, a connected Battlefield universe filled with immersive experiences built on our unique DNA.
   

  

 LET’S PUSH THINGS FORWARD
   

  

 DICE is a creative studio with offices in Stockholm and Gothenburg. We believe in the power of inclusion and welcome game creators from all backgrounds to collaborate with us as we unlock the potential for the future of Battlefield!
   

  

 We’re always pushing to be at the forefront of creative entertainment - blending digital art, design, and technology to push boundaries. Our collaborative culture is fueled by passion, driving innovation and making a positive difference for our players and community.
   

  

 At DICE, your ideas matter. We offer an inclusive space where you can thrive, be yourself, and grow alongside a team dedicated to making a meaningful impact to the world of gaming.
   

  

 We’re all-in on the future and our most ambitious Battlefield yet. Want to be part of something special? Read on.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The DICE Audio department is looking for a sound designer to join the Battlefield audio team in our mission to create amazing sounding games and player experiences. You are driven, curious, creative and have a passion for sound design. You are a problem solver and have a strong willingness to learn more about audio as a craft and push the boundaries of what is possible in game audio to create the best audible experience for our players.
   

  

 Above all you are an excellent listener and thrive in a collaborative creative environment. You are passionate about teamwork and collaboration both within the audio department but also cross teams, disciplines and studios.
   

  

 As a member of the DICE Audio department you will design sounds for our games and learn our tools and workflows. You will be working in an established and experienced audio team where you will find opportunities for creative growth and mentoring from more senior team members.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Produce content aligned with existing designs and audio direction, ensuring each piece contributes to a cohesive and high-quality soundscape by creating assets and implementations that meet both creative and technical goals.
* Collaborate under the guidance of a Lead to develop sounds for environments, game modes, destruction, and animations.
* Implement your work into the game using the Frostbite engine.
* Deliver high-quality audio within a given budget and timeline.
* Be structured; estimate your work, update plans, submit good data into the branch.
* Refine content and its underlying logic through playtesting and feedback sessions to ensure it meets quality standards and serves its intended purpose.
* Ask for and act on feedback concerning your work. Also provide feedback within the sound team, with a focus on audio execution.
* Be an active mixer for your assets and provide feedback on the title's overall mix.


**Qualifications**
* Experience in designing sounds for interactive or linear media.
* Strong understanding of how sound functions in real life, with an ability to balance realism and gameplay readability.
* Developed artistic skills, with a talent for interpreting references and following direction.
* Proficiency with modern studio hardware, editing and design techniques, and software like Reaper, ProTools, Sound Forge, Waves, iZotope RX, and FabFilter.
* Eagerness to enhance game audio production, implementation, and engineering skills.
* Exceptional critical listening abilities.
* Familiarity with audio middleware such as Unreal, FMOD, Unity, and WWISE is beneficial but not essential.
* Excellent communication skills.
* A team player who thrives in a collaborative creative environment.
* Passionate about teamwork and collaboration.
* Experience as a sound designer in AA-AAA game development is beneficial.
* Avid gamer with an interest in creating complex and realistic soundscapes.


**As Part Of Your Application, Please Provide**
* An up-to-date resume and cover letter
* A show-reel demonstrating your skills
* As part of the application process we ask you to perform a work assignment.


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
   

  

 Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Business Expert - Relevance & Ranking
description:
**Job Description**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
  

 We are looking for a Business Expert to lead data quality and search relevance for Elevate4, our enterprise search platform. In this role, you will help ensure that product data and product attributes are accurate, complete, consistent, enriched, and normalized so they can power strong discovery experiences across Search, Browse, and Recommendations.
   

  





 You will work across systems including Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Product Data Hub (PDH), Product Information Management (PIM), and Digital Curation Tool (DCT), helping improve how product data flows, how it is structured, and how it supports relevant and intuitive customer experiences. This is a backend-focused role centered on the data, logic, and platform capabilities behind discovery, rather than ownership of experience layers. Ranking will also be in scope where needed to strengthen overall discovery performance.
   

  





**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
  

 As a Business Expert, you will lead and improve data quality and search relevance for Elevate4, our enterprise search platform. You will help ensure that product data and product attributes are accurate, complete, consistent, enriched, and normalized so they can power strong discovery experiences across Search, Browse, and Recommendations.
   

  





*You will...*



* Own and improve the quality of product data and product attributes that power Search, Browse, and Recommendations in Elevate4.


* Build strong expertise in how product data flows across Elevate4 and connected systems, including AEM, PDH, PIM, and DCT, and identify opportunities to improve quality, consistency, and operational effectiveness.


* Drive improvements in product attribution, enrichment, normalization, search relevance, and intent understanding so data, attributes, business rules, and supporting signals work together to deliver accurate and intuitive discovery experiences.


* Support ranking improvements across Search, Browse, and Recommendations, while guiding stakeholders on questions related to product relevance and ranking across key discovery pages.


* Partner closely with Data Analysts, product teams, business stakeholders, third-party vendors and regional teams to evaluate impact, refine requirements, align business needs, and translate them into scalable and sustainable solutions.



**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**
  

 You will be part of the Relevance & Ranking team, working closely with Data Analysts, product teams, business stakeholders, third-party vendors, and regional teams. In this role, you will be a key business partner for product data quality, search relevance, ranking-related topics, and platform improvements, helping translate business needs into clear requirements and scalable ways of working.
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE**




*We are looking for people with…*



* Strong experience working with product data, data quality, data enrichment, and normalization in a digital commerce, search, or product discovery environment.


* Experience with Elevate4, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Hybris, or similar platforms, along with familiarity with product data ecosystems and cross-system data flows.


* Strong understanding of how product data quality and product attributes influence Search, Browse, and Recommendations, including search relevance and intent understanding.


* Familiarity with ranking concepts, taxonomy, normalization, indexing, customer intent, data quality, and relevance signals.


* Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technical teams.



*And people who are…*



* Comfortable working in complexity and confident navigating ambiguity.


* Motivated by improving how data and search work together to create better customer experiences.


* Able to bring clarity to cross-system challenges and turn uncertainty into actionable goals and plans.


* Collaborative, structured, and able to build trusted relationships across technical, business, and regional teams.


* Curious, proactive, and focused on continuous improvement and sustainable ways of working.



**WHO WE ARE**
  

 H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, scale, and knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**
  

 At H&M Group, we’re proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company where people can grow and make an impact.
   

  




* All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)


* Staff discount usable across all H&M Group brands, in stores and online


* Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation, and wellness allowance of 4000 SEK/year


* Access to Benify for discounts on gym memberships, travel, hotels, and more


* Compensation boost during parental leave



**JOIN US**
  

 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
   

  





 \*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

title: Digital Merchandiser – Skapa innehåll som inspirerar miljontals hemmafixare
description:
Vill du vara med och skapa en av Nordens bästa e-handelsupplevelser?
 


  


 På Byggmax har vi miljontals besökare varje månad och en e-handel som är avgörande för vår affär. Nu söker vi en Digital Merchandiser som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för innehållet och kundupplevelsen i våra digitala kanaler. Du kommer att säkerställa att rätt budskap, kampanjer och inspiration möter rätt kund vid rätt tillfälle, alltid med målet att skapa en enklare köpupplevelse och öka försäljningen.
 


  


 Det här är en roll för dig som gillar att kombinera kreativitet med analys och som drivs av att ständigt förbättra den digitala kundresan.
 


  


**Forma framtidens e-handelsupplevelse**

title: Senior Software Engineer
